verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, clean_start s0 -> cert (run tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ check_ok (core_of (run pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ commit_ok (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ certify_ok (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ chan (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = Some (claim (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c) /\ claim (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = mkfact p c (ver (core_of (run pre1 s0)) c) /\ ver (core_of (run pre1 s0)) c = ver (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ untouched (run (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: no_free_host_certification

verdicts.name: hcore_own_run

verdicts.name: generic_earned_certification_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, clean_start s0 -> cert (run tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ check_ok (core_of (run pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ commit_ok (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ certify_ok (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ ver (core_of (run pre1 s0)) c = ver (core_of (run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ untouched (run (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: generic_certified_run_min_cost
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, clean_start s0 -> cert (run tr s0) = true -> total_cost tr >= 3 /\ mu (run tr s0) >= mu s0 + 3

verdicts.name: sm2_step_inc

verdicts.name: sm2_incs_chain

verdicts.name: sm2_check_loop
verdicts.statement: forall Q o r Z rs, sm2_inQ Q o (sm2_whilel o r Z [M.CHECK UC.PSlot rs]) -> r <> Z -> rs <> r -> rs <> Z -> forall n s, M.pc (M.core_of s) = o + 1 -> M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> M.vals (M.core_of s) r = n -> UC.heval UC.PSlot (M.vals (M.core_of s) rs) = true -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) + n <= 16 -> exists s', sm2_RR Q s s' /\ M.pc (M.core_of s') = o + 7 /\ M.err (M.core_of s') = false /\ M.vals (M.core_of s') r = 0 /\ M.vals (M.core_of s') Z = M.vals (M.core_of s) Z /\ (forall q, q <> r -> M.vals (M.core_of s') q = M.vals (M.core_of s) q) /\ (forall q, q <> r -> q <> Z -> M.vers (M.core_of s') q = M.vers (M.core_of s) q) /\ M.facts (M.core_of s') = repeat (M.mkfact UC.PSlot rs (M.vers (M.core_of s) rs)) n ++ M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = M.chan (M.core_of s) /\ M.mu s' = M.mu s + n /\ M.cert s' = M.cert s

verdicts.name: sm2_commit_loop
verdicts.statement: forall Q o r Z rs, sm2_inQ Q o (sm2_whilel o r Z [M.COMMIT UC.PSlot rs]) -> r <> Z -> rs <> r -> rs <> Z -> forall n s, M.pc (M.core_of s) = o + 1 -> M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> M.vals (M.core_of s) r = n -> (1 <= n -> In (M.mkfact UC.PSlot rs (M.vers (M.core_of s) rs)) (M.facts (M.core_of s))) -> exists s', sm2_RR Q s s' /\ M.pc (M.core_of s') = o + 7 /\ M.err (M.core_of s') = false /\ M.vals (M.core_of s') r = 0 /\ M.vals (M.core_of s') Z = M.vals (M.core_of s) Z /\ (forall q, q <> r -> M.vals (M.core_of s') q = M.vals (M.core_of s) q) /\ (forall q, q <> r -> q <> Z -> M.vers (M.core_of s') q = M.vers (M.core_of s) q) /\ M.facts (M.core_of s') = M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ (n = 0 -> M.chan (M.core_of s') = M.chan (M.core_of s)) /\ (1 <= n -> M.chan (M.core_of s') = Some (M.mkfact UC.PSlot rs (M.vers (M.core_of s) rs))) /\ M.mu s' = M.mu s + n /\ M.cert s' = M.cert s

verdicts.name: ent2_untouched_prefix
verdicts.statement: forall s mid c, M.untouched E.prop_eqb E.eval s mid c -> forall t1 t2, mid = t1 ++ t2 -> M.vers (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval t1 s)) c = M.vers (M.core_of s) c /\ M.vals (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval t1 s)) c = M.vals (M.core_of s) c

verdicts.name: ent2_prop_eqb_eq
verdicts.statement: forall p q, E.prop_eqb p q = true <-> p = q

verdicts.name: ent2_chain_same
verdicts.statement: forall s0 pre1 p c (t1 t2 : list (@M.instr E.prop)), M.untouched E.prop_eqb E.eval (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval (pre1 ++ [M.CHECK p c]) s0) (t1 ++ t2) c -> M.vers (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval pre1 s0)) c = M.vers (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval (pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: t1) s0)) c /\ M.vals (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval pre1 s0)) c = M.vals (M.core_of (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval (pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: t1) s0)) c

verdicts.name: ent2_chain_holds
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, M.clean_start s0 -> M.cert (M.run E.prop_eqb E.eval tr s0) = true -> earned_chain ent2_minterface s0 tr

verdicts.name: ent2_mmachine_complete
verdicts.statement: thiele_complete_with ent2_minterface

verdicts.name: ent2_claim_eqb_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y, ent2_claim_eqb x y = true <-> x = y

verdicts.name: ent2_same_keeps
verdicts.statement: forall c s t, ti_same ent2_minterface c s t -> ti_meaning ent2_minterface c s -> ti_meaning ent2_minterface c t

verdicts.name: ent2_mmachine_complete_over
verdicts.statement: thiele_complete_over ent2_mmachine ent2_language

verdicts.name: ent2_in_all_bits
verdicts.statement: forall n x, In x (ent_all_bools n) <-> length x = n

verdicts.name: ent2_agree_length
verdicts.statement: forall ans x, length (ent2_agree ans x) = length ans

verdicts.name: ent2_agree_app
verdicts.statement: forall ans u, ent2_agree ans (ans ++ u) = map (fun _ => true) ans

verdicts.name: ent2_agree_flip
verdicts.statement: forall ans u, ent2_agree ans (map negb ans ++ u) = map (fun _ => false) ans

verdicts.name: ent2_agree_true_iff
verdicts.statement: forall ans x, forallb (fun b => b) (ent2_agree ans x) = true <-> exists u, x = ans ++ u

verdicts.name: ent2_eval_prop
verdicts.statement: forall b x, E.eval (ent2_prop b) (Nat.b2n x) = Bool.eqb b x

verdicts.name: ent2_skipn_cons
verdicts.statement: forall (v : list bool) i, i < length v -> skipn i v = nth i v false :: skipn (S i) v

verdicts.name: ent2_okb_world
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0 v, i0 + length ans <= length v -> ent2_okb ans i0 (ent2_vals v) = forallb (fun b => b) (ent2_agree ans (skipn i0 v))

verdicts.name: ent2_trapped_run
verdicts.statement: forall tr (s : mstate), M.err (M.core_of s) = true -> M.err (M.core_of (mrun tr s)) = true /\ M.cert (mrun tr s) = M.cert s

verdicts.name: ent2_checks_pass
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0 (s : mstate), M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> ent2_okb ans i0 (M.vals (M.core_of s)) = true -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) + length ans <= 16 -> M.err (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = false /\ M.vals (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = M.vals (M.core_of s) /\ M.vers (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = M.vers (M.core_of s) /\ M.cert (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s) = M.cert s /\ M.chan (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = M.chan (M.core_of s) /\ M.mu (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s) = M.mu s + length ans /\ exists new : list (@M.fact E.prop), M.facts (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = new ++ M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ length new = length ans /\ forall j, j < length ans -> In (M.mkfact (ent2_prop (nth j ans false)) (i0 + j) (M.vers (M.core_of s) (i0 + j))) new

verdicts.name: ent2_checks_fail
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0 (s : mstate), M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) <= 16 -> ~ (ent2_okb ans i0 (M.vals (M.core_of s)) = true /\ length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) + length ans <= 16) -> M.err (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s)) = true /\ M.cert (mrun (ent2_checks ans i0) s) = M.cert s

verdicts.name: ent2_qtrace_run
verdicts.statement: forall ans v, ans <> [] -> (ent2_okb ans 0 (ent2_vals v) = true /\ length ans <= 16 -> M.cert (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = true /\ M.mu (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = length ans + 2 /\ M.err (M.core_of (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v))) = false) /\ (~ (ent2_okb ans 0 (ent2_vals v) = true /\ length ans <= 16) -> M.cert (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = false)

verdicts.name: ent2_err_back
verdicts.statement: forall tr (s : mstate), M.err (M.core_of (mrun tr s)) = false -> M.err (M.core_of s) = false

verdicts.name: ent2_facts_le
verdicts.statement: forall tr (s : mstate), length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) <= 16 -> length (M.facts (M.core_of (mrun tr s))) <= 16

verdicts.name: ent2_facts_count
verdicts.statement: forall tr (s : mstate), M.err (M.core_of (mrun tr s)) = false -> length (M.facts (M.core_of (mrun tr s))) = length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) + ent2_count_checks tr

verdicts.name: ent2_questions_cap
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : mstate) tr, M.clean_start s0 -> M.cert (mrun tr s0) = true -> exists pre post, tr = pre ++ M.CERTIFY :: post /\ ent2_count_checks pre <= 16

verdicts.name: ent2_sum_split
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (f g : A -> nat) (l : list A), fold_right Nat.add 0 (map (fun x => f x + g x) l) = fold_right Nat.add 0 (map f l) + fold_right Nat.add 0 (map g l)

verdicts.name: ent2_sum_pos
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (f : A -> nat) (l : list A), (exists x, In x l /\ 1 <= f x) -> 1 <= fold_right Nat.add 0 (map f l)

verdicts.name: ent2_sum_le_mul
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (f : A -> nat) (c : nat) (l : list A), (forall x, In x l -> f x <= c) -> fold_right Nat.add 0 (map f l) <= length l * c

verdicts.name: ent2_cover_sum_gen
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (q : A -> A -> bool) (prior post : list A), (forall x, In x prior -> exists t, In t post /\ q t x = true) -> length prior <= fold_right Nat.add 0 (map (fun t => length (filter (q t) prior)) post)

verdicts.name: ent2_cover_sum
verdicts.statement: forall (r : X -> O) (prior post : list X), (forall x, In x prior -> exists t, In t post /\ r x = r t) -> length prior <= ent2_fibre_sum r prior post

verdicts.name: ent2_partition_old_iff
verdicts.statement: forall r T prior post, ent2_partition_old r T prior post <-> ent2_partition r T prior post

verdicts.name: ent2_partition_to_reduction
verdicts.statement: forall r T prior post, ent2_partition r T prior post -> ent_reduction r T prior post

verdicts.name: ent2_partition_bits
verdicts.statement: forall r T (prior post : list X), 0 < length post -> ent2_partition r T prior post -> Nat.log2_up (length prior) - Nat.log2_up (length post) <= ent_depth T

verdicts.name: ent2_reduction_not_partition
verdicts.statement: exists (prior post : list nat) (r : nat -> nat) (T : ent_tree), ent_reduction r T prior post /\ ~ ent2_partition Nat.eqb r T prior post

verdicts.name: ent2_mass_uniform
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} (l : list X), ent2_mass (map (fun x => (x, 1)) l) = length l

verdicts.name: ent2_weighted_bits
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} (T : ent_tree) (prior post : list (X * nat)), 0 < ent2_mass post -> ent2_wcovers T prior post -> Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass prior) - Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass post) <= ent_depth T

verdicts.name: ent2_wreduction_covers
verdicts.statement: forall {X O : Type} (r : X -> O) (T : ent_tree) (prior post : list (X * nat)), ent2_wreduction r T prior post -> ent2_wcovers T prior post

verdicts.name: ent2_weighted_cs
verdicts.statement: forall (C : CertificationSystem) {X : Type} (tr : list (cs_instr C)) (prior post : list (X * nat)) (T : ent_tree), 0 < ent2_mass post -> ent2_wcovers T prior post -> ent_depth T <= ent_cs_paid C tr -> Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass prior) - Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass post) <= ent_cs_bill C tr

verdicts.name: ent2_weighted_representation
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M) (X O : Type) (s0 : m_state M) (tr : list (m_move M)) (d : list (m_move M) -> O) (obs r : X -> O) (eqb : O -> O -> bool) (prior post : list (X * nat)) (T : ent_tree), thiele_complete_with I -> (forall o1 o2, eqb o1 o2 = true <-> o1 = o2) -> ent_strict_sublist (map fst post) (map fst prior) -> (exists w, In w (map fst prior) /\ ~ In w (map fst post) /\ ent_distinguishes obs w (map fst post)) -> ti_clean I s0 -> ent_certified I s0 tr d (ent_member eqb obs (map fst post)) -> ent_depth T <= record_moves I tr -> 0 < ent2_mass post -> ent2_wreduction r T prior post -> ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member eqb obs (map fst post)) (ent_member eqb obs (map fst prior)) /\ earned_chain I s0 tr /\ Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass prior) - Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass post) <= record_moves I tr /\ record_moves I tr = ti_ledger I (run M tr s0) - ti_ledger I s0 /\ ti_ledger I s0 + 3 <= ti_ledger I (run M tr s0)

verdicts.name: ent2_rise_independent
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M), exact_toll_clause I -> forall tr s s', ti_ledger I (run M tr s) - ti_ledger I s = ti_ledger I (run M tr s') - ti_ledger I s'

verdicts.name: ent2_expected_rise_exact
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M), exact_toll_clause I -> forall tr (prior : list (m_state M * nat)), ent2_expected_rise I tr prior = ent2_mass prior * record_moves I tr

verdicts.name: ent2_weighted_expected_bound
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M), exact_toll_clause I -> forall (tr : list (m_move M)) (prior post : list (m_state M * nat)) (T : ent_tree), 0 < ent2_mass post -> ent2_wcovers T prior post -> ent_depth T <= record_moves I tr -> (Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass prior) - Nat.log2_up (ent2_mass post)) * ent2_mass prior <= ent2_expected_rise I tr prior

verdicts.name: ent2_observed_representation
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M) (X O : Type) (s0 : m_state M) (tr : list (m_move M)) (d : list (m_move M) -> O) (obs r : X -> O) (eqb : O -> O -> bool) (prior post : list X) (T : ent_tree), exact_toll_clause I -> (forall o1 o2, eqb o1 o2 = true <-> o1 = o2) -> ent_strict_sublist post prior -> (exists w, In w prior /\ ~ In w post /\ ent_distinguishes obs w post) -> ent_member eqb obs post (d tr) = true -> ent_depth T <= record_moves I tr -> 0 < length post -> ent_reduction r T prior post -> ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member eqb obs post) (ent_member eqb obs prior) /\ Nat.log2_up (length prior) - Nat.log2_up (length post) <= record_moves I tr /\ record_moves I tr = ti_ledger I (run M tr s0) - ti_ledger I s0

verdicts.name: ent2_observed_partition_representation
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M) (X O : Type) (s0 : m_state M) (tr : list (m_move M)) (d : list (m_move M) -> O) (obs r : X -> O) (eqb : O -> O -> bool) (prior post : list X) (T : ent_tree), exact_toll_clause I -> (forall o1 o2, eqb o1 o2 = true <-> o1 = o2) -> ent_strict_sublist post prior -> (exists w, In w prior /\ ~ In w post /\ ent_distinguishes obs w post) -> ent_member eqb obs post (d tr) = true -> ent_depth T <= record_moves I tr -> 0 < length post -> ent2_partition eqb r T prior post -> ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member eqb obs post) (ent_member eqb obs prior) /\ Nat.log2_up (length prior) - Nat.log2_up (length post) <= record_moves I tr /\ record_moves I tr = ti_ledger I (run M tr s0) - ti_ledger I s0

verdicts.name: ent2_record_adds
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M), thiele_complete_with I -> forall s0 tr, ti_clean I s0 -> m_record M (run M tr s0) = true -> earned_chain I s0 tr /\ ti_ledger I s0 + 3 <= ti_ledger I (run M tr s0)

verdicts.name: ent2_upgrade_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M), thiele_complete_with I -> forall s0 tr, ti_clean I s0 -> (m_record M (run M tr s0) = true <-> earned_chain I s0 tr)

verdicts.name: ent2_every_observed_shortcut_lands_here
verdicts.statement: forall (M : machine) (I : thiele_interface M) (X O : Type) (s0 : m_state M) (tr : list (m_move M)) (sc : ent2_observed_shortcut I X O s0 tr), exact_toll_clause I -> ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member (ent2_os_eqb sc) (ent2_os_obs sc) (ent2_os_post sc)) (ent_member (ent2_os_eqb sc) (ent2_os_obs sc) (ent2_os_prior sc)) /\ Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_os_prior sc)) - Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_os_post sc)) <= ti_ledger I (run M tr s0) - ti_ledger I s0

verdicts.name: ent2_obs_depth
verdicts.statement: ent_depth (ent_complete 2) <= record_moves earned_interface ent2_obs_trace

verdicts.name: ent2_observed_small_instance
verdicts.statement: ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member ent_bools_eqb ent_obs ent_post) (ent_member ent_bools_eqb ent_obs ent_prior) /\ Nat.log2_up (length ent_prior) - Nat.log2_up (length ent_post) = 2 /\ E.mu (run earned_machine ent2_obs_trace ent_s0) - E.mu ent_s0 = 2 /\ Nat.log2_up (length ent_prior) - Nat.log2_up (length ent_post) <= E.mu (run earned_machine ent2_obs_trace ent_s0) - E.mu ent_s0 /\ E.cert (E.run ent2_obs_trace ent_s0) = false /\ ~ earned_chain earned_interface ent_s0 ent2_obs_trace /\ ~ (ti_ledger earned_interface ent_s0 + 3 <= ti_ledger earned_interface (run earned_machine ent2_obs_trace ent_s0))

verdicts.name: ent2_checks_length
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0, length (ent2_checks ans i0) = length ans

verdicts.name: ent2_filter_checks
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0, filter ent2_is_check (ent2_checks ans i0) = ent2_checks ans i0

verdicts.name: ent2_map_true
verdicts.statement: forall (l : list minstr) (ans : list bool), length l = length ans -> map (fun _ => true) l = map (fun _ => true) ans

verdicts.name: ent2_decode_qtrace
verdicts.statement: forall ans, ent2_decode (ent2_qtrace ans) = map (fun _ => true) ans

verdicts.name: ent2_record_moves_checks
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0, record_moves ent2_minterface (ent2_checks ans i0) = length ans

verdicts.name: ent2_record_moves_qtrace
verdicts.statement: forall ans, record_moves ent2_minterface (ent2_qtrace ans) = length ans + 2

verdicts.name: ent2_sum_const
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (f : A -> nat) c (l : list A), (forall x, In x l -> f x = c) -> fold_right Nat.add 0 (map f l) = length l * c

verdicts.name: ent2_prior_length
verdicts.statement: forall n, length (ent2_prior n) = 2 ^ n

verdicts.name: ent2_post_length
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, length (ent2_post ans m) = 2 ^ m

verdicts.name: ent2_in_post
verdicts.statement: forall ans m t, In t (ent2_post ans m) <-> exists u, length u = m /\ t = ans ++ u

verdicts.name: ent2_post_incl
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, incl (ent2_post ans m) (ent2_prior (length ans + m))

verdicts.name: ent2_skipn_app_len
verdicts.statement: forall (ans u : list bool), skipn (length ans) (ans ++ u) = u

verdicts.name: ent2_reduction
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, ent_reduction (fun x => skipn (length ans) x) (ent_complete (length ans)) (ent2_prior (length ans + m)) (ent2_post ans m)

verdicts.name: ent2_forallb_false
verdicts.statement: forall (a : bool) (r : list bool), forallb (fun b => b) (map (fun _ => false) (a :: r)) = false

verdicts.name: ent2_witness
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, ans <> [] -> In (ent2_rival ans m) (ent2_prior (length ans + m)) /\ ~ In (ent2_rival ans m) (ent2_post ans m) /\ ent_distinguishes (ent2_agree ans) (ent2_rival ans m) (ent2_post ans m)

verdicts.name: ent2_narrowing
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, ans <> [] -> ent_strict_sublist (ent2_post ans m) (ent2_prior (length ans + m))

verdicts.name: ent2_okb_prefix
verdicts.statement: forall ans u, ent2_okb ans 0 (ent2_vals (ans ++ u)) = true

verdicts.name: ent2_okb_iff
verdicts.statement: forall ans v, length ans <= length v -> ent2_okb ans 0 (ent2_vals v) = true <-> exists u, v = ans ++ u

verdicts.name: ent2_search_certifies_iff
verdicts.statement: forall ans v, ans <> [] -> length ans <= length v -> M.cert (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = true <-> (length ans <= 16 /\ exists u, v = ans ++ u)

verdicts.name: ent2_search_posterior_is_certified
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, ans <> [] -> length ans <= 16 -> forall v, In v (ent2_prior (length ans + m)) -> (In v (ent2_post ans m) <-> M.cert (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = true)

verdicts.name: ent2_no_search_past_16
verdicts.statement: forall ans v, ans <> [] -> 16 < length ans -> M.cert (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world v)) = false

verdicts.name: ent2_member_certified
verdicts.statement: forall ans u, ans <> [] -> length ans <= 16 -> ent_certified ent2_minterface (ent2_world (ans ++ u)) (ent2_qtrace ans) ent2_decode (ent_member ent_bools_eqb (ent2_agree ans) (ent2_post ans (length u)))

verdicts.name: ent2_bit_search
verdicts.statement: forall (ans u : list bool), ans <> [] -> length ans <= 16 -> ent_strictly_stronger (ent_member ent_bools_eqb (ent2_agree ans) (ent2_post ans (length u))) (ent_member ent_bools_eqb (ent2_agree ans) (ent2_prior (length ans + length u))) /\ earned_chain ent2_minterface (ent2_world (ans ++ u)) (ent2_qtrace ans) /\ length (ent2_prior (length ans + length u)) = 2 ^ (length ans + length u) /\ length (ent2_post ans (length u)) = 2 ^ length u /\ Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_prior (length ans + length u))) - Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_post ans (length u))) = length ans /\ record_moves ent2_minterface (ent2_qtrace ans) = length ans + 2 /\ M.mu (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world (ans ++ u))) - M.mu (ent2_world (ans ++ u)) = length ans + 2 /\ Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_prior (length ans + length u))) - Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_post ans (length u))) <= M.mu (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world (ans ++ u))) - M.mu (ent2_world (ans ++ u))

verdicts.name: ent2_search_lands
verdicts.statement: forall (ans u : list bool) (Hne : ans <> []) (Hle : length ans <= 16), Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_prior (length ans + length u))) - Nat.log2_up (length (ent2_post ans (length u))) <= M.mu (mrun (ent2_qtrace ans) (ent2_world (ans ++ u))) - M.mu (ent2_world (ans ++ u))

verdicts.name: ent2_checked_checks
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0, ent_checked ent2_minterface (ent2_checks ans i0) = ent2_claims ans i0

verdicts.name: ent2_checked_app
verdicts.statement: forall (l1 l2 : list minstr), ent_checked ent2_minterface (l1 ++ l2) = ent_checked ent2_minterface l1 ++ ent_checked ent2_minterface l2

verdicts.name: ent2_checked_qtrace
verdicts.statement: forall ans, ent_checked ent2_minterface (ent2_qtrace ans) = ent2_claims ans 0

verdicts.name: ent2_claims_length
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0, length (ent2_claims ans i0) = length ans

verdicts.name: ent2_answers_world
verdicts.statement: forall ans i0 v, i0 + length ans <= length v -> map (ti_check ent2_minterface (ent2_world v)) (ent2_claims ans i0) = ent2_agree ans (skipn i0 v)

verdicts.name: ent2_agree_prefix
verdicts.statement: forall ans w v, length ans <= length w -> length ans <= length v -> ent2_agree ans w = ent2_agree ans v -> firstn (length ans) w = firstn (length ans) v

verdicts.name: ent2_nodup_join
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (l l' : list A), NoDup l -> NoDup l' -> (forall a, In a l -> ~ In a l') -> NoDup (l ++ l')

verdicts.name: ent2_nodup_all_bits
verdicts.statement: forall n, NoDup (ent_all_bools n)

verdicts.name: ent2_filter_mono
verdicts.statement: forall {A : Type} (p q : A -> bool) (l : list A), (forall x, In x l -> p x = true -> q x = true) -> length (filter p l) <= length (filter q l)

verdicts.name: ent2_filter_map
verdicts.statement: forall {A B : Type} (f : B -> bool) (g : A -> B) (l : list A), filter f (map g l) = map g (filter (fun x => f (g x)) l)

verdicts.name: ent2_prefix_class
verdicts.statement: forall k m v, length v = k + m -> length (filter (fun w => ent_bools_eqb (firstn k w) (firstn k v)) (ent_all_bools (k + m))) <= 2 ^ m

verdicts.name: ent2_search_questions_floor
verdicts.statement: forall (ans : list bool) (m : nat), ans <> [] -> let prior := map ent2_world (ent_all_bools (length ans + m)) in let I := ent2_minterface in let tr := ent2_qtrace ans in length (ent_checked I tr) = length ans /\ Nat.log2_up (length prior) - Nat.log2_up (2 ^ m) = length ans /\ Nat.log2_up (length prior) - Nat.log2_up (2 ^ m) <= length (ent_checked I tr) /\ length (ent_checked I tr) <= record_moves I tr

verdicts.name: ent2_suffix_class
verdicts.statement: forall k m t, length (filter (fun w => ent_bools_eqb (skipn k w) (skipn k t)) (ent_all_bools (k + m))) <= 2 ^ k

verdicts.name: ent2_search_partition
verdicts.statement: forall ans m, ent2_partition ent_bools_eqb (fun x => skipn (length ans) x) (ent_complete (length ans)) (ent2_prior (length ans + m)) (ent2_post ans m)

verdicts.name: ent2_search_partition_bits

verdicts.name: generic_cs_cost

verdicts.name: earned_generic_floor

verdicts.name: earned_generic_certified_floor

verdicts.name: earned_generic_cs_sound

verdicts.name: sorted_certified_floor

verdicts.name: sorted_cs_sound

verdicts.name: thiele_complete_floor

verdicts.name: earned_complete_agrees

verdicts.name: generic_complete_agrees
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) (prop_eqb : prop -> prop -> bool) (eval : prop -> nat -> bool) (H : T.thiele_complete (T.generic_machine prop_eqb eval)) (tr : list (@G.instr prop)) (s : @G.state prop), cs_run (@complete_cs _ H) tr s = cs_run (generic_cs prop_eqb eval) tr s /\ cs_total_cost (@complete_cs _ H) tr = cs_total_cost (generic_cs prop_eqb eval) tr

verdicts.name: sorted_complete_agrees
verdicts.statement: forall (tr : list (@G.instr G.sprop)) (s : @G.state G.sprop), cs_run (@complete_cs _ T.sorted_machine_thiele_complete) tr s = cs_run sorted_cs tr s /\ cs_total_cost (@complete_cs _ T.sorted_machine_thiele_complete) tr = cs_total_cost sorted_cs tr

verdicts.name: complete_cs_window_blind
verdicts.statement: forall (M : T.machine) (H : T.thiele_complete M) (I : T.thiele_interface M), T.thiele_complete_with I -> (~ exists f : T.cm_conf -> bool, forall a b (tr : list (T.m_move M)), f (W.base_window I (cs_run (@complete_cs M H) tr (T.load I a b))) = cs_cert (@complete_cs M H) (cs_run (@complete_cs M H) tr (T.load I a b))) /\ (~ exists f : T.cm_conf -> nat, forall a b (tr : list (T.m_move M)), f (W.base_window I (cs_run (@complete_cs M H) tr (T.load I a b))) = T.ti_ledger I (cs_run (@complete_cs M H) tr (T.load I a b)))

verdicts.statement: prog_code [] = 0

verdicts.name: prog_code_cons
verdicts.statement: forall i P, prog_code (i :: P) = pair (icode i) (prog_code P)

verdicts.name: prog_code_inj
verdicts.statement: forall P Q, prog_code P = prog_code Q -> P = Q

verdicts.name: skip_code_S
verdicts.statement: forall code k, skip_code code (S k) = match unpair code with Some (_, t) => skip_code t k | None => 0 end

verdicts.name: fetch_code_S
verdicts.statement: forall code k, fetch_code code (S k) = match unpair code with Some (_, t) => fetch_code t k | None => None end

verdicts.name: fetch_code_skip
verdicts.statement: forall k code, fetch_code code k = option_map fst (unpair (skip_code code k))

verdicts.name: skip_code_encode
verdicts.statement: forall k l, skip_code (G.encode l) k = G.encode (skipn k l)

verdicts.name: fetch_code_encode
verdicts.statement: forall k l, fetch_code (G.encode l) k = nth_error l k

verdicts.name: nth_error_map_opt
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (l : list A) k, nth_error (map f l) k = option_map f (nth_error l k)

verdicts.name: skipn_map_comm
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (l : list A) k, skipn k (map f l) = map f (skipn k l)

verdicts.name: fetch_code_prog
verdicts.statement: forall P k, fetch_code (prog_code P) k = option_map icode (nth_error P k)

verdicts.name: skip_code_prog
verdicts.statement: forall P k, skip_code (prog_code P) k = prog_code (skipn k P)

verdicts.name: unpair_skip_prog
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, nth_error P k = Some i -> unpair (skip_code (prog_code P) k) = Some (icode i, prog_code (skipn (S k) P))

verdicts.name: skip_prog_past_end
verdicts.statement: forall P k, nth_error P k = None -> skip_code (prog_code P) k = 0

verdicts.name: fetch_decode_prog
verdicts.statement: forall P k, match fetch_code (prog_code P) k with Some x => idecode x | None => None end = nth_error P k

verdicts.name: guest_fetch_code
verdicts.statement: forall P k, option_map icode (E.fetch P (S k)) = fetch_code (prog_code P) k

verdicts.name: host_earned_certification_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @M.state hprop) (tr : list (@M.instr hprop)), M.clean_start s0 -> M.cert (M.run hprop_eqb heval tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ M.COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ M.CERTIFY :: post /\ M.check_ok heval (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ M.commit_ok hprop_eqb (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval (pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ M.certify_ok (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval (pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ M.COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ M.vers (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval pre1 s0)) c = M.vers (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval (pre1 ++ M.CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ M.untouched hprop_eqb heval (M.run hprop_eqb heval (pre1 ++ [M.CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: host_slot_soundness
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @M.state hprop) (tr : list (@M.instr hprop)) (f : @M.fact hprop), M.clean_start s0 -> let k := M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval tr s0) in In f (M.facts k) -> M.f_ver f = M.vers k (M.f_reg f) -> exists p v, M.vals k (M.f_reg f) = pair (pcode p) v /\ E.holds p v

verdicts.name: host_committed_slot_holds
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @M.state hprop) (tr : list (@M.instr hprop)) r, M.clean_start s0 -> M.commit_ok hprop_eqb (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval tr s0)) PSlot r = true -> exists p v, M.vals (M.core_of (M.run hprop_eqb heval tr s0)) r = pair (pcode p) v /\ E.holds p v

verdicts.name: pigeonhole_not_injective
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (Q : list A) (f : nat -> A), (forall n, In (f n) Q) -> ~ (forall n m, f n = f m -> n = m)

verdicts.name: collide
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y}) (f : nat -> A) (ns : list nat) (Q : list A), NoDup ns -> (forall n, In n ns -> In (f n) Q) -> length Q < length ns -> exists n m, n <> m /\ f n = f m

verdicts.name: pigeonhole_collision
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y}) (Q : list A) (f : nat -> A), (forall n, In (f n) Q) -> exists n m, n <> m /\ f n = f m

verdicts.name: guest_check_passes
verdicts.statement: forall n m a b, n <= a -> C.err (C.core_of (C.run_prog 1 (guest n m) (C.start a b))) = false

verdicts.name: guest_traps
verdicts.statement: forall n m a b, n <> m -> C.err (C.core_of (C.run_prog 2 (guest n m) (C.start a b))) = true

verdicts.name: host_same_prop_succeeds
verdicts.statement: forall (s : @M.state hprop) q R, M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) < M.fact_cap -> heval q (M.vals (M.core_of s) R) = true -> let s' := M.run hprop_eqb heval [M.CHECK q R; M.COMMIT q R] s in M.err (M.core_of s') = false /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = Some (M.mkfact q R (M.vers (M.core_of s) R))

verdicts.name: no_exact_copy_host
verdicts.statement: forall (Q : list hprop) (tr : C.prop -> hprop), (forall p, In (tr p) Q) -> (forall p v, C.eval p v = true -> heval (tr p) v = true) -> exists n m, n <> m /\ C.PGe n <> C.PGe m /\ tr (C.PGe n) = tr (C.PGe m) /\ (forall a b, C.err (C.core_of (C.run_prog 2 (guest n m) (C.start a b))) = true) /\ (forall a b (R : nat) (s : @M.state hprop), n <= a -> M.vals (M.core_of s) R = a -> M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) < M.fact_cap -> C.err (C.core_of (C.run_prog 1 (guest n m) (C.start a b))) = false /\ C.err (C.core_of (C.run_prog 2 (guest n m) (C.start a b))) = true /\ let s' := M.run hprop_eqb heval [M.CHECK (tr (C.PGe n)) R; M.COMMIT (tr (C.PGe m)) R] s in M.err (M.core_of s') = false /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = Some (M.mkfact (tr (C.PGe m)) R (M.vers (M.core_of s) R)))

verdicts.name: vec_pos_inj
verdicts.statement: forall n (rs : vec nat n), NoDup (vec_list rs) -> forall p q, vec_pos rs p = vec_pos rs q -> p = q

verdicts.name: vec_pos_not_in
verdicts.statement: forall n (rs : vec nat n) r, ~ In r (vec_list rs) -> forall p, vec_pos rs p <> r

verdicts.name: agree_hvec
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat) k, agree rho k (hvec rho k)

verdicts.name: trace_of_halted
verdicts.statement: forall m P s, M.halted P (M.core_of s) -> trace_of m P s = []

verdicts.name: trace_of_add
verdicts.statement: forall n m P s, trace_of (n + m) P s = trace_of n P s ++ trace_of m P (run_prog n P s)

verdicts.name: run_vers_mono
verdicts.statement: forall tr s r, hver s r <= hver (run tr s) r

verdicts.name: run_same_ver_same_val
verdicts.statement: forall tr s r, hver (run tr s) r = hver s r -> hv (run tr s) r = hv s r

verdicts.name: hrun_refl
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s, hrun Ph s s

verdicts.name: hrun_trans
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s1 s2 s3, hrun Ph s1 s2 -> hrun Ph s2 s3 -> hrun Ph s1 s3

verdicts.name: hrun_same_sub
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s s', hrun Ph s s' -> same_sub s s'

verdicts.name: hrun_vers_mono
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s s', hrun Ph s s' -> forall r, hver s r <= hver s' r

verdicts.name: hrun_val_moved
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s s', hrun Ph s s' -> forall r, hv s' r <> hv s r -> hver s r < hver s' r

verdicts.name: hframe_refl
verdicts.statement: forall rs s, hframe rs s s

verdicts.name: hframe_trans
verdicts.statement: forall rs1 rs2 s1 s2 s3, hframe rs1 s1 s2 -> hframe rs2 s2 s3 -> hframe (rs1 ++ rs2) s1 s3

verdicts.name: hframe_incl
verdicts.statement: forall rs rs' s s', incl rs rs' -> hframe rs s s' -> hframe rs' s s'

verdicts.name: subcode_fetch
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (l Ph : list instr) q i, subcode (o, l) (1, Ph) -> nth_error l q = Some i -> M.fetch Ph (o + q) = Some i

verdicts.name: host_step_fetch
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s i, M.fetch Ph (hpc s) = Some i -> herr s = false -> i <> M.HALT -> step Ph s = exec s i

verdicts.name: host_step_at
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s o i, subcode (o, [i]) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> i <> M.HALT -> run_prog 1 Ph s = exec s i

verdicts.name: host_trace_at
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s o i, subcode (o, [i]) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> i <> M.HALT -> trace_of 1 Ph s = [i]

verdicts.name: lift_plain
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat) i, M.plain (lift rho i) = true

verdicts.name: lift_not_halt
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat) i, lift rho i <> M.HALT

verdicts.name: lift_mentions_out
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat) i r, (forall p, rho p <> r) -> M.mentions (lift rho i) r = false

verdicts.name: lift_cexec
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat), (forall p q, rho p = rho q -> p = q) -> forall ins i v j w (k : core), mma_sss ins (i, v) (j, w) -> M.pc k = i -> M.err k = false -> agree rho k v -> let k' := cexec k (lift rho ins) in M.pc k' = j /\ M.err k' = false /\ agree rho k' w /\ (forall r, M.vers k' r = if Nat.eqb (M.vals k' r) (M.vals k r) then M.vers k r else S (M.vers k r))

verdicts.name: lift_steps
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat), (forall p q, rho p = rho q -> p = q) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr), subcode (o, map (lift rho) B) (1, Ph) -> forall m st st', sss_steps (@mma_sss n) (o, B) m st st' -> forall s, hpc s = fst st -> herr s = false -> agree rho (M.core_of s) (snd st) -> hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = fst st' /\ herr (run_prog m Ph s) = false /\ agree rho (M.core_of (run_prog m Ph s)) (snd st') /\ Forall (fun i => In i (map (lift rho) B)) (trace_of m Ph s) /\ length (trace_of m Ph s) = m

verdicts.name: mma_compute_host
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat), (forall p q, rho p = rho q -> p = q) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr) i v j w s, subcode (o, map (lift rho) B) (1, Ph) -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (i, v) (j, w) -> hpc s = i -> herr s = false -> agree rho (M.core_of s) v -> exists m, hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = j /\ agree rho (M.core_of (run_prog m Ph s)) w /\ same_sub s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ hrun Ph s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ Forall (fun ins => In ins (map (lift rho) B)) (trace_of m Ph s) /\ (forall r, (forall ins, In ins B -> M.mentions (lift rho ins) r = false) -> hv (run_prog m Ph s) r = hv s r /\ hver (run_prog m Ph s) r = hver s r) /\ (forall r, hver s r <= hver (run_prog m Ph s) r) /\ (forall r, hv (run_prog m Ph s) r <> hv s r -> hver s r < hver (run_prog m Ph s) r)

verdicts.name: mma_compute_host_regs
verdicts.statement: forall n o B (Ph : list instr) i v j w s, subcode (o, map (lift (@pos2nat n)) B) (1, Ph) -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (i, v) (j, w) -> hpc s = i -> herr s = false -> (forall p, hv s (pos2nat p) = vec_pos v p) -> exists m, hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = j /\ (forall p, hv (run_prog m Ph s) (pos2nat p) = vec_pos w p) /\ same_sub s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ hrun Ph s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ (forall r, n <= r -> hv (run_prog m Ph s) r = hv s r /\ hver (run_prog m Ph s) r = hver s r)

verdicts.name: mma_block_host
verdicts.statement: forall n (rs : vec nat n), NoDup (vec_list rs) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr) s j w, subcode (o, map (lift (vec_pos rs)) B) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (o, hvec (vec_pos rs) (M.core_of s)) (j, w) -> exists s', hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = j /\ (forall p, hv s' (vec_pos rs p) = vec_pos w p) /\ hframe (vec_list rs) s s'

verdicts.name: sc_app_l
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (l1 l2 Ph : list hinstr), subcode (o, l1 ++ l2) (1, Ph) -> subcode (o, l1) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: sc_app_r
verdicts.statement: forall (o n : nat) (l1 l2 Ph : list hinstr), n = length l1 + o -> subcode (o, l1 ++ l2) (1, Ph) -> subcode (n, l2) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: sc_cons_l
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (i : hinstr) l Ph, subcode (o, i :: l) (1, Ph) -> subcode (o, [i]) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: sc_cons_r
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (i : hinstr) l Ph, subcode (o, i :: l) (1, Ph) -> subcode (S o, l) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: sc_pos
verdicts.statement: forall (n m : nat) (l Ph : list hinstr), n = m -> subcode (n, l) (1, Ph) -> subcode (m, l) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: hstep1
verdicts.statement: forall Ph s o i, subcode (o, [i]) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> M.plain i = true -> Hrun Ph s (hexec s i)

verdicts.name: hexec_plain_sub
verdicts.statement: forall s i, M.plain i = true -> same_sub s (hexec s i)

verdicts.name: p01_2
verdicts.statement: (pos0 : pos 2) <> pos1

verdicts.name: p01
verdicts.statement: (pos0 : pos 3) <> pos1

verdicts.name: p02
verdicts.statement: (pos0 : pos 3) <> pos2

verdicts.name: p12
verdicts.statement: (pos1 : pos 3) <> pos2

verdicts.name: nd1
verdicts.statement: forall a : nat, NoDup (vec_list (a ## vec_nil))

verdicts.name: nd2
verdicts.statement: forall a b : nat, a <> b -> NoDup (vec_list (a ## b ## vec_nil))

verdicts.name: nd3
verdicts.statement: forall a b c : nat, a <> b -> a <> c -> b <> c -> NoDup (vec_list (a ## b ## c ## vec_nil))

verdicts.name: hINC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, hINC r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' r = S (hv s r) /\ hver s' r = S (hver s r) /\ hframe [r] s s'

verdicts.name: hDEC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall r j o Ph s, subcode (o, hDEC r j o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [r] s s' /\ match hv s r with | 0 => hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' r = 0 /\ hver s' r = hver s r | S u => hpc s' = j /\ hv s' r = u /\ hver s' r = S (hver s r) end

verdicts.name: hJMP_length
verdicts.statement: forall a p o, length (hJMP a p o) = JMP_len

verdicts.name: hJZ_length
verdicts.statement: forall x p o, length (hJZ x p o) = JZ_len

verdicts.name: hZERO_length
verdicts.statement: forall x o, length (hZERO x o) = ZERO_len

verdicts.name: hMOVE_length
verdicts.statement: forall x y o, length (hMOVE x y o) = MOVE_len

verdicts.name: hMOVE2_length
verdicts.statement: forall x y z o, length (hMOVE2 x y z o) = MOVE2_len

verdicts.name: hPACK_length
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o, length (hPACK a x y o) = PACK_len

verdicts.name: hHALF_length
verdicts.statement: forall a x p o, length (hHALF a x p o) = HALF_len

verdicts.name: hUNPACK_length
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o, length (hUNPACK a x y o) = UNPACK_len

verdicts.name: hJMP_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a p o Ph s, subcode (o, hJMP a p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = p /\ hv s' a = hv s a /\ hframe [a] s s'

verdicts.name: hJZ_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x p o Ph s, subcode (o, hJZ x p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = (match hv s x with 0 => p | S _ => JZ_len + o end) /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hframe [x] s s'

verdicts.name: hZERO_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x o Ph s, subcode (o, hZERO x o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ hframe [x] s s'

verdicts.name: hMOVE_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y o Ph s, x <> y -> subcode (o, hMOVE x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = MOVE_len + o /\ hv s' y = hv s y + hv s x /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ hframe [x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: hMOVE2_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y z o Ph s, x <> y -> x <> z -> y <> z -> subcode (o, hMOVE2 x y z o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = MOVE2_len + o /\ hv s' y = hv s y + hv s x /\ hv s' z = hv s z + hv s x /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ hframe [x; y; z] s s'

verdicts.name: hPACK_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> subcode (o, hPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = PACK_len + o /\ hv s' x = pair (hv s y) (hv s x) /\ hv s' y = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: hHALF_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x p o Ph s, a <> x -> subcode (o, hHALF a x p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = (if snd (half (hv s x)) then p else HALF_len + o) /\ hv s' x = fst (half (hv s x)) /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hframe [a; x] s s'

verdicts.name: hUNPACK_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y m n o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> hv s x = pair m n -> subcode (o, hUNPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = UNPACK_len + o /\ hv s' x = n /\ hv s' y = m /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: hUNPACK0_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> hv s x = 0 -> subcode (o, hUNPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = 0 /\ hv s' a = hv s a /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ hv s' y = hv s y /\ hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: hrun_err
verdicts.statement: forall Ph (s s' : hstate), Hrun Ph s s' -> herr s = false -> herr s' = false

verdicts.name: hCOPY_length
verdicts.statement: forall x y t o, length (hCOPY x y t o) = COPY_len

verdicts.name: hCOPY_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y t o Ph s, x <> y -> x <> t -> y <> t -> subcode (o, hCOPY x y t o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = COPY_len + o /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hv s' y = hv s x /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ hframe [x; y; t] s s'

verdicts.name: hDISP_length
verdicts.statement: forall x t ps o, length (hDISP x t ps o) = 3 * length ps

verdicts.name: hDISP_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x t ps o Ph s, x <> t -> subcode (o, hDISP x t ps o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [x; t] s s' /\ hv s' t = hv s t /\ (hv s x < length ps -> hpc s' = nth (hv s x) ps 0 /\ hv s' x = 0) /\ (length ps <= hv s x -> hpc s' = 3 * length ps + o /\ hv s' x = hv s x - length ps)

verdicts.name: hEQC_length
verdicts.statement: forall x c t u p o, length (hEQC x c t u p o) = EQC_len c

verdicts.name: nth_repeat_last
verdicts.statement: forall c f p v, v < S c -> nth v (repeat f c ++ [p]) 0 = if Nat.eqb v c then p else f

verdicts.name: hEQC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x c t u p o Ph s, x <> t -> x <> u -> t <> u -> subcode (o, hEQC x c t u p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [x; t; u] s s' /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ hv s' u = 0 /\ hpc s' = (if Nat.eqb (hv s x) c then p else EQC_len c + o)

verdicts.name: hEQR_length
verdicts.statement: forall x y t1 t2 u p o, length (hEQR x y t1 t2 u p o) = EQR_len

verdicts.name: hEQR_loop
verdicts.statement: forall x y t1 t2 u p o Ph, t1 <> t2 -> t1 <> u -> t2 <> u -> subcode (o, hEQR x y t1 t2 u p o) (1, Ph) -> forall a b s, hpc s = EQR_loop o -> herr s = false -> hv s t1 = a -> hv s t2 = b -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [t1; t2; u] s s' /\ hv s' u = hv s u /\ (a = b -> hpc s' = p /\ hv s' t1 = 0 /\ hv s' t2 = 0) /\ (a <> b -> hpc s' = EQR_ne o)

verdicts.name: hEQR_spec

verdicts.name: hFETCH_loop
verdicts.statement: forall prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph, w <> kk -> w <> h -> w <> a -> kk <> h -> kk <> a -> h <> a -> subcode (o, hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> forall k s, hpc s = FETCH_loop o -> herr s = false -> hv s kk = k -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [w; kk; h; a] s s' /\ match fetch_code (hv s w) k with | Some c => hpc s' = FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = c /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = skip_code (hv s w) (S k) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end

verdicts.name: hFETCH_spec
verdicts.statement: forall prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph s, NoDup [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] -> subcode (o, hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] s s' /\ hv s' prog = hv s prog /\ hv s' gpc = hv s gpc /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ match hv s gpc with | 0 => hpc s' = pz /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' w = hv s prog | S k => match fetch_code (hv s prog) k with | Some c => hpc s' = FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = c /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = skip_code (hv s prog) (S k) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end end

verdicts.name: hFETCH_guest
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph s k, NoDup [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] -> subcode (o, hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s prog = prog_code P -> hv s gpc = S k -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hframe [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] s s' /\ hv s' prog = prog_code P /\ hv s' gpc = S k /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ match nth_error P k with | Some i => hpc s' = FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = icode i /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = prog_code (skipn (S k) P) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end

verdicts.statement: forall c n k0 o Ph s, k0 + n <= 16 -> subcode (o, fam (fun k o' => hBUMP (SLOT c k) (MP c k) o') BUMP_len k0 n o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = n * BUMP_len + o /\ (forall k, k0 <= k < k0 + n -> hv s' (SLOT c k) = hv s (SLOT c k) /\ hver s' (SLOT c k) = 2 + hver s (SLOT c k) /\ hv s' (MP c k) = 0) /\ (forall r, (forall k, k0 <= k < k0 + n -> r <> SLOT c k /\ r <> MP c k) -> hv s' r = hv s r /\ hver s' r = hver s r) /\ (forall r, (forall k, k0 <= k < k0 + n -> r <> MP c k) -> hv s' r = hv s r)

verdicts.name: hBUMPS_spec
verdicts.statement: forall c o Ph s, subcode (o, hBUMPS c o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = BUMPS_len + o /\ (forall q, q < 16 -> hv s' (SLOT c q) = hv s (SLOT c q) /\ hver s' (SLOT c q) = 2 + hver s (SLOT c q) /\ hv s' (MP c q) = 0) /\ hfr (fun r => in_mp c r \/ in_slots c r) s s' /\ vfr (in_mp c) s s'

verdicts.name: hEQRS_gen
verdicts.statement: forall c tgt n k0 o Ph s, k0 + n <= 16 -> subcode (o, fam (fun k o' => hEQR (MP c k) T2 T7 T8 T4 (tgt k) o') EQR_len k0 n o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ ((hv s T7 = 0 /\ hv s T8 = 0 /\ hv s T4 = 0) \/ 0 < n -> hv s' T7 = 0 /\ hv s' T8 = 0 /\ hv s' T4 = 0) /\ vfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4) s s' /\ hfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4 \/ r = T2 \/ in_mp c r) s s' /\ (forall j, k0 <= j < k0 + n -> hv s (MP c j) = hv s T2 -> (forall j', k0 <= j' < j -> hv s (MP c j') <> hv s T2) -> hpc s' = tgt j) /\ ((forall j, k0 <= j < k0 + n -> hv s (MP c j) <> hv s T2) -> hpc s' = n * EQR_len + o)

verdicts.name: hEQRS_spec
verdicts.statement: forall c tgt o Ph s, subcode (o, hEQRS c tgt o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hv s' T7 = 0 /\ hv s' T8 = 0 /\ hv s' T4 = 0 /\ vfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4) s s' /\ hfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4 \/ r = T2 \/ in_mp c r) s s' /\ (forall j, j < 16 -> hv s (MP c j) = hv s T2 -> (forall j', j' < j -> hv s (MP c j') <> hv s T2) -> hpc s' = tgt j) /\ ((forall j, j < 16 -> hv s (MP c j) <> hv s T2) -> hpc s' = 16 * EQR_len + o)

verdicts.name: hHALTB_spec

verdicts.name: hHEAD_spec

verdicts.name: hINCH_spec

verdicts.name: hCKH_disp
verdicts.statement: forall c o Ph s, subcode (o, hCKH c o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hv s' T4 = 0 /\ vfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T4) s s' /\ hframe [NC c; T7; T4] s s' /\ (hv s (NC c) < 16 -> hpc s' = CKS_at o (hv s (NC c)) /\ hv s' T7 = 0) /\ (16 <= hv s (NC c) -> hpc s' = CKH_dead o /\ hv s' T7 = hv s (NC c) - 16)

verdicts.name: hCKS_pre

verdicts.name: hCKS_post

verdicts.name: hCMH_search
verdicts.statement: forall c o Ph s, subcode (o, hCMH c o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hv s' T2 = S (hv s T2) /\ hv s' T7 = 0 /\ hv s' T8 = 0 /\ hv s' T4 = 0 /\ vfr (fun r => r = T2 \/ r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4) s s' /\ hfr (fun r => r = T7 \/ r = T8 \/ r = T4 \/ r = T2 \/ in_mp c r) s s' /\ (forall j, j < 16 -> hv s (MP c j) = S (hv s T2) -> (forall j', j' < j -> hv s (MP c j') <> S (hv s T2)) -> hpc s' = CMS_at o j) /\ ((forall j, j < 16 -> hv s (MP c j) <> S (hv s T2)) -> hpc s' = CMH_dead o)

verdicts.name: phase_check_pass

verdicts.statement: forall P s p c j, at_head P s -> E.fetch P (hv s GPC) = Some (E.CHECK p c) -> hv s (NC c) = j -> j < 16 -> hv s (SLOT c j) = 0 -> ~ E.holds p (hv s (greg c)) \/ M.fact_cap <= length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) -> exists s', hreach s s' /\ herr s' = true /\ hpc s' = CKS_chk (CKS_at (L_CKH c) j) /\ M.facts (M.core_of s') = M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = M.chan (M.core_of s) /\ M.mu s' = M.mu s + 1 /\ M.cert s' = M.cert s /\ hv s' (SLOT c j) = pair (pcode p) (hv s (greg c)) /\ hv s' T2 = pcode p /\ (forall r, r <> T2 -> r <> SLOT c j -> hv s' r = hv s r) /\ (forall r, 48 <= r -> r <> SLOT c j -> hver s' r = hver s r)

verdicts.name: phase_check_dead

verdicts.name: phase_commit_pass

verdicts.name: universal_earned
verdicts.statement: forall P x y n, M.cert (hrun P x y n) = true -> exists c k p v pre1 mid1 mid2 post, k < 16 /\ htrace n U (hload P x y) = pre1 ++ M.CHECK PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid1 ++ M.COMMIT PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid2 ++ M.CERTIFY :: post /\ M.check_ok heval (M.core_of (hrun_l pre1 (hload P x y))) PSlot (SLOT c k) = true /\ M.commit_ok hprop_eqb (M.core_of (hrun_l (pre1 ++ M.CHECK PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid1) (hload P x y))) PSlot (SLOT c k) = true /\ M.certify_ok (M.core_of (hrun_l (pre1 ++ M.CHECK PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid1 ++ M.COMMIT PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid2) (hload P x y))) = true /\ hver (hrun_l pre1 (hload P x y)) (SLOT c k) = hver (hrun_l (pre1 ++ M.CHECK PSlot (SLOT c k) :: mid1) (hload P x y)) (SLOT c k) /\ M.untouched hprop_eqb heval (hrun_l (pre1 ++ [M.CHECK PSlot (SLOT c k)]) (hload P x y)) mid1 (SLOT c k) /\ hv (hrun_l pre1 (hload P x y)) (SLOT c k) = pair (pcode p) v /\ E.holds p v /\ exists m gpre gmid1 gmid2 gpost, E.trace_of m P (E.start x y) = gpre ++ E.CHECK p c :: gmid1 ++ E.COMMIT p c :: gmid2 ++ E.CERTIFY :: gpost /\ E.check_ok (E.core_of (E.run gpre (E.start x y))) p c = true /\ E.commit_ok (E.core_of (E.run (gpre ++ E.CHECK p c :: gmid1) (E.start x y))) p c = true /\ E.certify_ok (E.core_of (E.run (gpre ++ E.CHECK p c :: gmid1 ++ E.COMMIT p c :: gmid2) (E.start x y))) = true /\ E.ver (E.core_of (E.run gpre (E.start x y))) c = E.ver (E.core_of (E.run (gpre ++ E.CHECK p c :: gmid1) (E.start x y))) c /\ E.untouched (E.run (gpre ++ [E.CHECK p c]) (E.start x y)) gmid1 c /\ E.val (E.core_of (E.run gpre (E.start x y))) c = v

verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) (prop_eqb : prop -> prop -> bool) (eval : prop -> nat -> bool) (tr : list (@M.instr prop)), cs_total_cost (multi_cs prop_eqb eval) tr = M.total_cost tr

verdicts.name: multi_cs_floor
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) (prop_eqb : prop -> prop -> bool) (eval : prop -> nat -> bool) (tr : list (@M.instr prop)) (s0 : @M.state prop), M.cert s0 = false -> M.cert (M.run prop_eqb eval tr s0) = true -> M.total_cost tr >= 1

verdicts.name: interp_cs_runs_U
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) (x y n : nat), cs_run interp_cs (M.trace_of C.hprop_eqb C.heval n Kernel.UniversalLayout.U (Kernel.UniversalSim.hload P x y)) (Kernel.UniversalSim.hload P x y) = R.hrun P x y n

verdicts.name: interp_U_certified_floor
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) (x y n : nat), M.cert (R.hrun P x y n) = true -> cs_total_cost interp_cs (M.trace_of C.hprop_eqb C.heval n Kernel.UniversalLayout.U (Kernel.UniversalSim.hload P x y)) >= 3

verdicts.name: interp_halting_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) (x y : nat), EarnedCoreLinks.EARNED_HALTING (P, x, y) <-> INTERP_HALTING (P, x, y)

verdicts.name: interp_halting_undecidable
verdicts.statement: undecidable INTERP_HALTING

verdicts.name: interp_complete_agrees
verdicts.statement: forall (tr : list (@M.instr C.hprop)) (s : @M.state C.hprop), cs_run interp_complete_cs tr s = cs_run interp_cs tr s /\ cs_total_cost interp_complete_cs tr = cs_total_cost interp_cs tr

verdicts.name: interp_U_complete_floor
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) (x y n : nat), M.cert (R.hrun P x y n) = true -> cs_total_cost interp_complete_cs (M.trace_of C.hprop_eqb C.heval n Kernel.UniversalLayout.U (Kernel.UniversalSim.hload P x y)) >= 1

verdicts.name: multi_cs_no_exact_copy
verdicts.statement: forall (hprop : Type) (hprop_eqb : hprop -> hprop -> bool), (forall p q, hprop_eqb p q = true <-> p = q) -> forall (heval : hprop -> nat -> bool) (Q : list hprop) (tr : E.prop -> hprop), (forall p, In (tr p) Q) -> (forall p v, E.eval p v = true -> heval (tr p) v = true) -> exists n m, n <> m /\ tr (E.PGe n) = tr (E.PGe m) /\ (forall a b, E.err (E.core_of (E.run_prog 2 (N.guest n m) (E.start a b))) = true) /\ (forall a (r : nat) (s : @M.state hprop), n <= a -> M.vals (M.core_of s) r = a -> M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) < M.fact_cap -> M.err (M.core_of (cs_run (multi_cs hprop_eqb heval) [M.CHECK (tr (E.PGe n)) r; M.COMMIT (tr (E.PGe m)) r] s)) = false /\ M.chan (M.core_of (cs_run (multi_cs hprop_eqb heval) [M.CHECK (tr (E.PGe n)) r; M.COMMIT (tr (E.PGe m)) r] s)) = Some (M.mkfact (tr (E.PGe m)) r (M.vers (M.core_of s) r)))

verdicts.name: pr_run_app
verdicts.statement: forall l1 l2 s, pr_run (l1 ++ l2) s = pr_run l2 (pr_run l1 s)

verdicts.name: pr_run_snoc
verdicts.statement: forall l i s, pr_run (l ++ [i]) s = pr_exec (pr_run l s) i

verdicts.name: pr_total_cost_app
verdicts.statement: forall l1 l2, pr_total_cost (l1 ++ l2) = pr_total_cost l1 + pr_total_cost l2

verdicts.name: pr_base_blind
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.core_of (pr_exec s i) = pr_cexec (G.core_of s) i

verdicts.name: pr_run_prog_halted
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, pr_halted P (G.core_of s) -> pr_run_prog n P s = s

verdicts.name: pr_run_prog_trace
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, pr_run_prog n P s = pr_run (pr_trace_of n P s) s

verdicts.name: pr_trapped_inert
verdicts.statement: forall k i, G.err k = true -> pr_cexec k i = k

verdicts.name: pr_run_prog_trapped
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, G.err (G.core_of s) = true -> pr_run_prog n P s = s

verdicts.name: pr_pay_neutral
verdicts.statement: forall s, let s' := pr_exec s PAY in G.ca (G.core_of s') = G.ca (G.core_of s) /\ G.cb (G.core_of s') = G.cb (G.core_of s) /\ G.va (G.core_of s') = G.va (G.core_of s) /\ G.vb (G.core_of s') = G.vb (G.core_of s) /\ G.facts (G.core_of s') = G.facts (G.core_of s) /\ G.chan (G.core_of s') = G.chan (G.core_of s) /\ G.err (G.core_of s') = G.err (G.core_of s) /\ G.cert s' = G.cert s /\ G.mu s' = G.mu s + 1 /\ G.pc (G.core_of s') = (if G.err (G.core_of s) then G.pc (G.core_of s) else S (G.pc (G.core_of s)))

verdicts.name: pr_pay_exec
verdicts.statement: forall s, G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> pr_exec s PAY = G.mkst (G.goto (G.core_of s) (S (G.pc (G.core_of s)))) (G.mu s + 1) (G.cert s)

verdicts.name: pr_pay_never_fires
verdicts.statement: forall k, pr_fires k PAY = false

verdicts.name: pr_cexec_embed
verdicts.statement: forall k i, pr_cexec k (pr_embed i) = G.cexec prop_eqb eval k i

verdicts.name: pr_exec_embed
verdicts.statement: forall s i, pr_exec s (pr_embed i) = G.exec prop_eqb eval s i

verdicts.name: pr_cost_embed
verdicts.statement: forall i, pr_cost (pr_embed i) = G.cost i

verdicts.name: pr_run_embed
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, pr_run (map pr_embed tr) s = G.run prop_eqb eval tr s

verdicts.name: pr_fetch_map
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (l : list A) n, G.fetch (map f l) n = option_map f (G.fetch l n)

verdicts.name: pr_next_instr_embed
verdicts.statement: forall P k, pr_next_instr (map pr_embed P) k = option_map pr_embed (G.next_instr P k)

verdicts.name: priced_extends_generic
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, pr_run_prog n (map pr_embed P) s = G.run_prog prop_eqb eval n P s /\ pr_trace_of n (map pr_embed P) s = map pr_embed (G.trace_of prop_eqb eval n P s) /\ (pr_halted (map pr_embed P) (G.core_of s) <-> G.halted P (G.core_of s))

verdicts.name: pr_pay_free_is_generic
verdicts.statement: forall P : list pr_instr, ~ In PAY P -> exists Q, P = map pr_embed Q

verdicts.name: pr_mu_conservation
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.mu (pr_exec s i) = G.mu s + pr_cost i

verdicts.name: pr_mu_conservation_trace
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, G.mu (pr_run tr s) = G.mu s + pr_total_cost tr

verdicts.name: pr_mu_conservation_program
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, G.mu (pr_run_prog n P s) = G.mu s + pr_total_cost (pr_trace_of n P s)

verdicts.name: pr_cert_latch
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.cert (pr_exec s i) = G.cert s || pr_fires (G.core_of s) i

verdicts.name: pr_cert_permanent
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.cert s = true -> G.cert (pr_exec s i) = true

verdicts.name: pr_only_certify_certifies
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.cert s = false -> G.cert (pr_exec s i) = true -> i = CERTIFY /\ G.certify_ok (G.core_of s) = true

verdicts.name: pr_a2
verdicts.statement: forall s i, G.cert s = false -> G.cert (pr_exec s i) = true -> pr_cost i >= 1

verdicts.name: pr_nfi_floor
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, G.cert s = false -> G.cert (pr_run tr s) = true -> pr_total_cost tr >= 1

verdicts.name: pr_ver_mono
verdicts.statement: forall k i c, G.ver k c <= G.ver (pr_cexec k i) c

verdicts.name: pr_ver_same_val
verdicts.statement: forall k i c, G.ver (pr_cexec k i) c = G.ver k c -> G.val (pr_cexec k i) c = G.val k c

verdicts.name: pr_ver_check
verdicts.statement: forall k p c d, G.ver (pr_cexec k (CHECK p c)) d = G.ver k d

verdicts.name: pr_val_check
verdicts.statement: forall k p c d, G.val (pr_cexec k (CHECK p c)) d = G.val k d

verdicts.name: pr_facts_step
verdicts.statement: forall k i f, In f (G.facts (pr_cexec k i)) -> In f (G.facts k) \/ (i = CHECK (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f) /\ check_ok k (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f) = true /\ f = G.claim k (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f))

verdicts.name: pr_facts_keep
verdicts.statement: forall k i f, In f (G.facts k) -> In f (G.facts (pr_cexec k i))

verdicts.name: pr_full_table_traps
verdicts.statement: forall k p c, G.fact_cap <= length (G.facts k) -> G.err (pr_cexec k (CHECK p c)) = true /\ G.facts (pr_cexec k (CHECK p c)) = G.facts k

verdicts.name: pr_facts_bounded_step
verdicts.statement: forall k i, length (G.facts k) <= G.fact_cap -> length (G.facts (pr_cexec k i)) <= G.fact_cap

verdicts.name: pr_chan_step
verdicts.statement: forall k i, G.chan (pr_cexec k i) = G.chan k \/ exists p c, i = COMMIT p c /\ commit_ok k p c = true /\ G.chan (pr_cexec k i) = Some (G.claim k p c)

verdicts.name: pr_unearned_commit_traps
verdicts.statement: forall k p c, commit_ok k p c = false -> G.err (pr_cexec k (COMMIT p c)) = true /\ G.chan (pr_cexec k (COMMIT p c)) = G.chan k /\ G.facts (pr_cexec k (COMMIT p c)) = G.facts k

verdicts.name: pr_uncommitted_certify_traps
verdicts.statement: forall s, G.certify_ok (G.core_of s) = false -> G.err (G.core_of (pr_exec s CERTIFY)) = true /\ G.cert (pr_exec s CERTIFY) = G.cert s

verdicts.name: pr_facts_length_step
verdicts.statement: forall k i, length (G.facts (pr_cexec k i)) = length (G.facts k) + pr_passes k i

verdicts.name: pr_facts_count
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, length (G.facts (G.core_of (pr_run tr s))) = length (G.facts (G.core_of s)) + pr_passing_checks tr s

verdicts.name: pr_facts_count_clean
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, G.clean_start s -> length (G.facts (G.core_of (pr_run tr s))) = pr_passing_checks tr s

verdicts.name: pr_facts_count_program
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, length (G.facts (G.core_of (pr_run_prog n P s))) = length (G.facts (G.core_of s)) + pr_passing_checks (pr_trace_of n P s) s

verdicts.name: pr_ver_mono_run
verdicts.statement: forall l s c, G.ver (G.core_of s) c <= G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run l s)) c

verdicts.name: pr_untouched_of_ver
verdicts.statement: forall s mid c, G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run mid s)) c = G.ver (G.core_of s) c -> pr_untouched s mid c

verdicts.name: pr_untouched_prefix
verdicts.statement: forall s mid c, pr_untouched s mid c -> forall t1 t2, mid = t1 ++ t2 -> G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run t1 s)) c = G.ver (G.core_of s) c /\ G.val (G.core_of (pr_run t1 s)) c = G.val (G.core_of s) c

verdicts.name: pr_sound_step
verdicts.statement: forall k i, G.sound holds k -> G.sound holds (pr_cexec k i)

verdicts.name: pr_sound_run
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, G.sound holds (G.core_of s) -> G.sound holds (G.core_of (pr_run tr s))

verdicts.name: pr_checker_soundness
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr f, G.clean_start s0 -> let k := G.core_of (pr_run tr s0) in In f (G.facts k) -> G.f_ver f = G.ver k (G.f_ctr f) -> holds (G.f_prop f) (G.val k (G.f_ctr f))

verdicts.name: pr_committed_claim_holds
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr p c, G.clean_start s0 -> commit_ok (G.core_of (pr_run tr s0)) p c = true -> holds p (G.val (G.core_of (pr_run tr s0)) c)

verdicts.name: pr_earned_intro
verdicts.statement: forall s0 pre mid f, check_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre s0)) (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f) = true -> f = G.claim (G.core_of (pr_run pre s0)) (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f) -> pr_earned s0 (pre ++ CHECK (G.f_prop f) (G.f_ctr f) :: mid) f

verdicts.name: pr_no_forging_step
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr i, pr_no_forgery s0 tr -> pr_no_forgery s0 (tr ++ [i])

verdicts.name: pr_no_forging
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, G.clean_start s0 -> pr_no_forgery s0 tr

verdicts.name: pr_earned_commitment_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall s0 pre p c, G.clean_start s0 -> commit_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre s0)) p c = true -> exists pre1 mid, pre = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid /\ check_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ pr_cost (CHECK p c) >= 1 /\ pr_cost (COMMIT p c) >= 1 /\ G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) c = G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run pre s0)) c /\ pr_untouched (pr_run (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid c

verdicts.name: pr_cert_first
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, G.cert s0 = false -> G.cert (pr_run tr s0) = true -> exists pre post, tr = pre ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ G.cert (pr_run pre s0) = false /\ G.certify_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre s0)) = true

verdicts.name: pr_chan_origin
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr f, G.chan (G.core_of s0) = None -> G.chan (G.core_of (pr_run tr s0)) = Some f -> exists pre1 p c mid, tr = pre1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid /\ commit_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ f = G.claim (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) p c

verdicts.name: pr_earned_certification_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ check_ok (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ commit_ok (G.core_of (pr_run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ G.certify_ok (G.core_of (pr_run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run pre1 s0)) c = G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ pr_untouched (pr_run (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: pr_certified_run_min_cost
verdicts.statement: forall s0 tr, G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run tr s0) = true -> pr_total_cost tr >= 3 /\ G.mu (pr_run tr s0) >= G.mu s0 + 3

verdicts.name: pr_program_certified_min_cost
verdicts.statement: forall n P a b, G.cert (pr_run_prog n P (start a b)) = true -> G.mu (pr_run_prog n P (start a b)) >= 3

verdicts.name: pr_exec_check_pass
verdicts.statement: forall s p c, check_ok (G.core_of s) p c = true -> pr_exec s (CHECK p c) = G.mkst (G.record_fact (G.core_of s) (G.claim (G.core_of s) p c)) (G.mu s + 1) (G.cert s)

verdicts.name: pr_exec_check_fail
verdicts.statement: forall s p c, G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> check_ok (G.core_of s) p c = false -> pr_exec s (CHECK p c) = G.mkst (G.trap (G.core_of s)) (G.mu s + 1) (G.cert s)

verdicts.name: pr_exec_commit_pass
verdicts.statement: forall s p c, commit_ok (G.core_of s) p c = true -> pr_exec s (COMMIT p c) = G.mkst (G.commit_to (G.core_of s) (G.claim (G.core_of s) p c)) (G.mu s + 1) (G.cert s)

verdicts.name: pr_chain_certifies
verdicts.statement: forall p c a b, holds p (G.val (start_core a b) c) -> G.cert (pr_run_prog 4 (pr_chain p c) (start a b)) = true /\ G.mu (pr_run_prog 4 (pr_chain p c) (start a b)) = 3

verdicts.name: pr_chain_refused_forever
verdicts.statement: forall n p c a b, ~ holds p (G.val (start_core a b) c) -> G.cert (pr_run_prog n (pr_chain p c) (start a b)) = false /\ (n >= 1 -> G.err (G.core_of (pr_run_prog n (pr_chain p c) (start a b))) = true)

verdicts.name: pr_chain_certifies_iff
verdicts.statement: forall p c a b, G.cert (pr_run_prog 4 (pr_chain p c) (start a b)) = true <-> holds p (G.val (start_core a b) c)

verdicts.name: pr_core_earned_certification_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.cprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.cprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ G.check_ok G.ceval (G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ G.commit_ok G.cprop_eqb (G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ G.certify_ok (G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval pre1 s0)) c = G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ pr_untouched G.cprop_eqb G.ceval (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: pr_core_checker_soundness
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.cprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.cprop)) (f : @G.fact G.cprop), G.clean_start s0 -> let k := G.core_of (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval tr s0) in In f (G.facts k) -> G.f_ver f = G.ver k (G.f_ctr f) -> G.cholds (G.f_prop f) (G.val k (G.f_ctr f))

verdicts.name: pr_core_no_forging
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.cprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.cprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> pr_no_forgery G.cprop_eqb G.ceval s0 tr

verdicts.name: pr_core_certified_run_min_cost
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.cprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.cprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval tr s0) = true -> pr_total_cost tr >= 3 /\ G.mu (pr_run G.cprop_eqb G.ceval tr s0) >= G.mu s0 + 3

verdicts.name: pr_core_zero_chain_iff
verdicts.statement: forall a b, G.cert (pr_run_prog G.cprop_eqb G.ceval 4 (pr_chain G.PZero G.CA) (G.start a b)) = true <-> a = 0

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_earned_certification_provenance
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.sprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.sprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0) = true -> exists pre1 p c mid1 mid2 post, tr = pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2 ++ CERTIFY :: post /\ G.check_ok G.seval (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval pre1 s0)) p c = true /\ G.commit_ok G.sprop_eqb (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) p c = true /\ G.certify_ok (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1 ++ COMMIT p c :: mid2) s0)) = true /\ G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval pre1 s0)) c = G.ver (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval (pre1 ++ CHECK p c :: mid1) s0)) c /\ pr_untouched G.sprop_eqb G.seval (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval (pre1 ++ [CHECK p c]) s0) mid1 c

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_checker_soundness
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.sprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.sprop)) (f : @G.fact G.sprop), G.clean_start s0 -> let k := G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0) in In f (G.facts k) -> G.f_ver f = G.ver k (G.f_ctr f) -> G.sholds (G.f_prop f) (G.val k (G.f_ctr f))

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_no_forging
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.sprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.sprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> pr_no_forgery G.sprop_eqb G.seval s0 tr

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_certified_run_min_cost
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.sprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.sprop)), G.clean_start s0 -> G.cert (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0) = true -> pr_total_cost tr >= 3 /\ G.mu (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0) >= G.mu s0 + 3

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_committed_claim_holds
verdicts.statement: forall (s0 : @G.state G.sprop) (tr : list (@pr_instr G.sprop)) c, G.clean_start s0 -> G.commit_ok G.sprop_eqb (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0)) G.PSorted c = true -> Sorted le (G.decode (G.val (G.core_of (pr_run G.sprop_eqb G.seval tr s0)) c))

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_run_certifies_iff
verdicts.statement: forall a b, G.cert (pr_run_prog G.sprop_eqb G.seval 4 pr_sorted_run (G.start a b)) = true <-> Sorted le (G.decode a)

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_run_certifies
verdicts.statement: forall a b, Sorted le (G.decode a) -> G.cert (pr_run_prog G.sprop_eqb G.seval 4 pr_sorted_run (G.start a b)) = true /\ G.mu (pr_run_prog G.sprop_eqb G.seval 4 pr_sorted_run (G.start a b)) = 3

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_run_refused_forever
verdicts.statement: forall n a b, ~ Sorted le (G.decode a) -> G.cert (pr_run_prog G.sprop_eqb G.seval n pr_sorted_run (G.start a b)) = false

verdicts.name: pr_sorted_demo_certifies

verdicts.name: presented_no_exact_below_three

verdicts.name: presented_extra_at_least

verdicts.name: cg_x_tail

verdicts.name: cg_run_prog_add
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) eqb ev a b (Q : list (@P.pr_instr prop)) s, P.pr_run_prog eqb ev (a + b) Q s = P.pr_run_prog eqb ev b Q (P.pr_run_prog eqb ev a Q s)

verdicts.name: cg_run_prog_stay
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) eqb ev (Q : list (@P.pr_instr prop)) s N N', P.pr_halted Q (G.core_of (P.pr_run_prog eqb ev N Q s)) -> N <= N' -> P.pr_run_prog eqb ev N' Q s = P.pr_run_prog eqb ev N Q s

verdicts.name: cg_cert_mono

verdicts.name: cg_trace_succ
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) eqb ev (Q : list (@P.pr_instr prop)) N s, P.pr_trace_of eqb ev (S N) Q s = P.pr_trace_of eqb ev N Q s ++ match P.pr_next_instr Q (G.core_of (P.pr_run_prog eqb ev N Q s)) with | Some i => [i] | None => [] end

verdicts.name: cg_passing_app
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) eqb ev l1 l2 (s : @G.state prop), P.pr_passing_checks eqb ev (l1 ++ l2) s = P.pr_passing_checks eqb ev l1 s + P.pr_passing_checks eqb ev l2 (P.pr_run eqb ev l1 s)

verdicts.name: cg_passing_sum

verdicts.name: cg_psum_mono

verdicts.name: cg_psum_ge

verdicts.name: cg_psum_two

verdicts.name: cg_guest_matching_points

verdicts.name: cg_guest_halts_at

verdicts.name: cg_y_new
verdicts.statement: forall m, rd (presented_run M s0 m) = true -> (forall m', m' < m -> rd (presented_run M s0 m') = false) -> exists L ex a, G.pc (G.core_of (Yrun s0 L)) = lnk (cg_NEW M pc) /\ cg_simul K (ex, a) (Yrun s0 L) /\ cg_a_earned a = false /\ cg_a_cert a = false /\ ex 0 = sc (presented_run M s0 m) /\ cg_ueval (URun R) (cg_gk K ex) = true

verdicts.name: cg_guest_earned
verdicts.statement: forall N, G.cert (Yrun s0 N) = true -> P.pr_passing_checks cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval (P.pr_trace_of cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval N cg_guest (cg_ystart s0)) (cg_ystart s0) = 1 /\ exists L m, L < N /\ rd (presented_run M s0 m) = true /\ (forall m', m' < m -> rd (presented_run M s0 m') = false) /\ P.pr_next_instr cg_guest (G.core_of (Yrun s0 L)) = Some (P.CHECK (URun R) G.CB) /\ G.check_ok cg_ueval (G.core_of (Yrun s0 L)) (URun R) G.CB = true /\ pm_sdec M (cg_expo (qs 0) (G.cb (G.core_of (Yrun s0 L)))) = Some (presented_run M s0 m) /\ (forall L', L' < N -> cg_passes_at cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval cg_guest (cg_ystart s0) L' = 1 -> L' = L)

verdicts.name: pu_host_earned_certification_provenance

verdicts.name: pu_lift_cexec

verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat), (forall p q, rho p = rho q -> p = q) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr), subcode (o, map (pu_lift rho) B) (1, Ph) -> forall m st st', sss_steps (@mma_sss n) (o, B) m st st' -> forall s, hpc s = fst st -> herr s = false -> pu_agree rho (M.core_of s) (snd st) -> hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = fst st' /\ herr (run_prog m Ph s) = false /\ pu_agree rho (M.core_of (run_prog m Ph s)) (snd st') /\ Forall (fun i => In i (map (pu_lift rho) B)) (trace_of m Ph s) /\ length (trace_of m Ph s) = m

verdicts.name: pu_mma_compute_host
verdicts.statement: forall n (rho : pos n -> nat), (forall p q, rho p = rho q -> p = q) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr) i v j w s, subcode (o, map (pu_lift rho) B) (1, Ph) -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (i, v) (j, w) -> hpc s = i -> herr s = false -> pu_agree rho (M.core_of s) v -> exists m, hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = j /\ pu_agree rho (M.core_of (run_prog m Ph s)) w /\ pu_same_sub s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ pu_hrun Ph s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ Forall (fun ins => In ins (map (pu_lift rho) B)) (trace_of m Ph s) /\ (forall r, (forall ins, In ins B -> M.pu_mentions (pu_lift rho ins) r = false) -> hv (run_prog m Ph s) r = hv s r /\ hver (run_prog m Ph s) r = hver s r) /\ (forall r, hver s r <= hver (run_prog m Ph s) r) /\ (forall r, hv (run_prog m Ph s) r <> hv s r -> hver s r < hver (run_prog m Ph s) r)

verdicts.name: pu_mma_compute_host_regs
verdicts.statement: forall n o B (Ph : list instr) i v j w s, subcode (o, map (pu_lift (@pos2nat n)) B) (1, Ph) -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (i, v) (j, w) -> hpc s = i -> herr s = false -> (forall p, hv s (pos2nat p) = vec_pos v p) -> exists m, hpc (run_prog m Ph s) = j /\ (forall p, hv (run_prog m Ph s) (pos2nat p) = vec_pos w p) /\ pu_same_sub s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ pu_hrun Ph s (run_prog m Ph s) /\ (forall r, n <= r -> hv (run_prog m Ph s) r = hv s r /\ hver (run_prog m Ph s) r = hver s r)

verdicts.name: pu_mma_block_host
verdicts.statement: forall n (rs : vec nat n), NoDup (vec_list rs) -> forall o B (Ph : list instr) s j w, subcode (o, map (pu_lift (vec_pos rs)) B) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> sss_compute (@mma_sss n) (o, B) (o, pu_hvec (vec_pos rs) (M.core_of s)) (j, w) -> exists s', pu_hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = j /\ (forall p, hv s' (vec_pos rs p) = vec_pos w p) /\ pu_hframe (vec_list rs) s s'

verdicts.name: pu_sc_app_l
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (l1 l2 Ph : list hinstr), subcode (o, l1 ++ l2) (1, Ph) -> subcode (o, l1) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: pu_sc_app_r
verdicts.statement: forall (o n : nat) (l1 l2 Ph : list hinstr), n = length l1 + o -> subcode (o, l1 ++ l2) (1, Ph) -> subcode (n, l2) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: pu_sc_cons_l

verdicts.name: pu_sc_cons_r
verdicts.statement: forall (o : nat) (i : hinstr) l Ph, subcode (o, i :: l) (1, Ph) -> subcode (S o, l) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: pu_sc_pos
verdicts.statement: forall (n m : nat) (l Ph : list hinstr), n = m -> subcode (n, l) (1, Ph) -> subcode (m, l) (1, Ph)

verdicts.name: pu_hINC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hINC r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' r = S (hv s r) /\ hver s' r = S (hver s r) /\ pu_hframe [r] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hDEC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall r j o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hDEC r j o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [r] s s' /\ match hv s r with | 0 => hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' r = 0 /\ hver s' r = hver s r | S u => hpc s' = j /\ hv s' r = u /\ hver s' r = S (hver s r) end

verdicts.name: pu_hJMP_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a p o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hJMP a p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = p /\ hv s' a = hv s a /\ pu_hframe [a] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hJZ_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x p o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hJZ x p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = (match hv s x with 0 => p | S _ => JZ_len + o end) /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ pu_hframe [x] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hZERO_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hZERO x o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = S o /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ pu_hframe [x] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hMOVE_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y o Ph s, x <> y -> subcode (o, pu_hMOVE x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = MOVE_len + o /\ hv s' y = hv s y + hv s x /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ pu_hframe [x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hMOVE2_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y z o Ph s, x <> y -> x <> z -> y <> z -> subcode (o, pu_hMOVE2 x y z o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = MOVE2_len + o /\ hv s' y = hv s y + hv s x /\ hv s' z = hv s z + hv s x /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ pu_hframe [x; y; z] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hPACK_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> subcode (o, pu_hPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = PACK_len + o /\ hv s' x = pu_pair (hv s y) (hv s x) /\ hv s' y = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ pu_hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hHALF_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x p o Ph s, a <> x -> subcode (o, pu_hHALF a x p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = (if snd (half (hv s x)) then p else HALF_len + o) /\ hv s' x = fst (half (hv s x)) /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ pu_hframe [a; x] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hUNPACK_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y m n o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> hv s x = pu_pair m n -> subcode (o, pu_hUNPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = UNPACK_len + o /\ hv s' x = n /\ hv s' y = m /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ pu_hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hUNPACK0_spec
verdicts.statement: forall a x y o Ph s, a <> x -> a <> y -> x <> y -> hv s x = 0 -> subcode (o, pu_hUNPACK a x y o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = 0 /\ hv s' a = hv s a /\ hv s' x = 0 /\ hv s' y = hv s y /\ pu_hframe [a; x; y] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hrun_err

verdicts.name: pu_hCOPY_length
