verdicts.name: pu_hCOPY_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y t o Ph s, x <> y -> x <> t -> y <> t -> subcode (o, pu_hCOPY x y t o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = pu_COPY_len + o /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hv s' y = hv s x /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ pu_hframe [x; y; t] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hDISP_length
verdicts.statement: forall x t ps o, length (pu_hDISP x t ps o) = 3 * length ps

verdicts.name: pu_hDISP_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x t ps o Ph s, x <> t -> subcode (o, pu_hDISP x t ps o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [x; t] s s' /\ hv s' t = hv s t /\ (hv s x < length ps -> hpc s' = nth (hv s x) ps 0 /\ hv s' x = 0) /\ (length ps <= hv s x -> hpc s' = 3 * length ps + o /\ hv s' x = hv s x - length ps)

verdicts.name: pu_hEQC_length
verdicts.statement: forall x c t u p o, length (pu_hEQC x c t u p o) = pu_EQC_len c

verdicts.name: pu_nth_repeat_last
verdicts.statement: forall c f p v, v < S c -> nth v (repeat f c ++ [p]) 0 = if Nat.eqb v c then p else f

verdicts.name: pu_hEQC_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x c t u p o Ph s, x <> t -> x <> u -> t <> u -> subcode (o, pu_hEQC x c t u p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [x; t; u] s s' /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ hv s' u = 0 /\ hpc s' = (if Nat.eqb (hv s x) c then p else pu_EQC_len c + o)

verdicts.name: pu_hEQR_length
verdicts.statement: forall x y t1 t2 u p o, length (pu_hEQR x y t1 t2 u p o) = pu_EQR_len

verdicts.name: pu_hEQR_loop
verdicts.statement: forall x y t1 t2 u p o Ph, t1 <> t2 -> t1 <> u -> t2 <> u -> subcode (o, pu_hEQR x y t1 t2 u p o) (1, Ph) -> forall a b s, hpc s = pu_EQR_loop o -> herr s = false -> hv s t1 = a -> hv s t2 = b -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [t1; t2; u] s s' /\ hv s' u = hv s u /\ (a = b -> hpc s' = p /\ hv s' t1 = 0 /\ hv s' t2 = 0) /\ (a <> b -> hpc s' = pu_EQR_ne o)

verdicts.name: pu_hEQR_spec
verdicts.statement: forall x y t1 t2 u p o Ph s, NoDup [x; y; t1; t2; u] -> subcode (o, pu_hEQR x y t1 t2 u p o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [x; y; t1; t2; u] s s' /\ hv s' x = hv s x /\ hv s' y = hv s y /\ hv s' t1 = 0 /\ hv s' t2 = 0 /\ hv s' u = 0 /\ hpc s' = (if Nat.eqb (hv s x) (hv s y) then p else pu_EQR_len + o)

verdicts.name: pu_hFETCH_length
verdicts.statement: forall prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o, length (pu_hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) = pu_FETCH_len

verdicts.name: pu_fetch_code_zero
verdicts.statement: forall k, pu_fetch_code 0 k = None

verdicts.name: pu_fetch_code_0
verdicts.statement: forall c, pu_fetch_code c 0 = option_map fst (pu_unpair c)

verdicts.name: pu_hFETCH_loop
verdicts.statement: forall prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph, w <> kk -> w <> h -> w <> a -> kk <> h -> kk <> a -> h <> a -> subcode (o, pu_hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> forall k s, hpc s = pu_FETCH_loop o -> herr s = false -> hv s kk = k -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [w; kk; h; a] s s' /\ match pu_fetch_code (hv s w) k with | Some c => hpc s' = pu_FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = c /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = pu_skip_code (hv s w) (S k) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end

verdicts.name: pu_hFETCH_spec
verdicts.statement: forall prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph s, NoDup [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] -> subcode (o, pu_hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] s s' /\ hv s' prog = hv s prog /\ hv s' gpc = hv s gpc /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ match hv s gpc with | 0 => hpc s' = pz /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' w = hv s prog | S k => match pu_fetch_code (hv s prog) k with | Some c => hpc s' = pu_FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = c /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = pu_skip_code (hv s prog) (S k) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end end

verdicts.name: pu_hFETCH_guest
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph s k, NoDup [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] -> subcode (o, pu_hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s prog = pu_prog_code P -> hv s gpc = S k -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] s s' /\ hv s' prog = pu_prog_code P /\ hv s' gpc = S k /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ match nth_error P k with | Some i => hpc s' = pu_FETCH_len + o /\ hv s' h = pu_icode i /\ hv s' kk = 0 /\ hv s' a = 0 /\ hv s' w = pu_prog_code (skipn (S k) P) | None => hpc s' = pe /\ hv s' w = 0 end

verdicts.name: pu_hFETCH_guest_pc0
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o Ph s, NoDup [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] -> subcode (o, pu_hFETCH prog gpc w kk h a t pz pe o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s prog = pu_prog_code P -> hv s gpc = 0 -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ pu_hframe [prog; gpc; w; kk; h; a; t] s s' /\ hv s' prog = pu_prog_code P /\ hv s' gpc = 0 /\ hv s' t = 0 /\ hpc s' = pz

verdicts.name: pu_hBUMP_length

verdicts.name: pu_hBUMP_spec
verdicts.statement: forall sl mp o Ph s, sl <> mp -> subcode (o, pu_hBUMP sl mp o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> exists s', Hrun Ph s s' /\ hpc s' = pu_BUMP_len + o /\ hv s' sl = hv s sl /\ hver s' sl = 2 + hver s sl /\ hv s' mp = 0 /\ pu_hframe [sl; mp] s s'

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_step

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_pass
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s p v, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s r = pu_pair (pu_pcode p) v -> E.holds p v -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) < M.pu_fact_cap -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_record_fact (M.core_of s) (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r))) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_pass_fields
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s p v, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s r = pu_pair (pu_pcode p) v -> E.holds p v -> length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) < M.pu_fact_cap -> let s' := hrun_prog 1 Ph s in M.facts (M.core_of s') = M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r) :: M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = M.chan (M.core_of s) /\ hpc s' = S o /\ herr s' = false /\ M.mu s' = M.mu s + 1 /\ M.cert s' = M.cert s /\ (forall d, hv s' d = hv s d /\ hver s' d = hver s d)

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_fail
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> M.pu_check_ok pu_heval (M.core_of s) PSlot r = false -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_fail_holds
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s p v, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s r = pu_pair (pu_pcode p) v -> ~ E.holds p v -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_fail_cap
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> M.pu_fact_cap <= length (M.facts (M.core_of s)) -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCHECK_fail_zero
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCHECK r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> hv s r = 0 -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCOMMIT_pass
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCOMMIT r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> In (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r)) (M.facts (M.core_of s)) -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_commit_to (M.core_of s) (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r))) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCOMMIT_pass_fields
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCOMMIT r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> In (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r)) (M.facts (M.core_of s)) -> let s' := hrun_prog 1 Ph s in M.facts (M.core_of s') = M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ M.chan (M.core_of s') = Some (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r)) /\ hpc s' = S o /\ herr s' = false /\ M.mu s' = M.mu s + 1 /\ M.cert s' = M.cert s /\ (forall d, hv s' d = hv s d /\ hver s' d = hver s d)

verdicts.name: pu_hCOMMIT_fail
verdicts.statement: forall r o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCOMMIT r o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> ~ In (M.mkfact PSlot r (hver s r)) (M.facts (M.core_of s)) -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hCERTIFY_pass
verdicts.statement: forall o Ph s f, subcode (o, pu_hCERTIFY o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> M.chan (M.core_of s) = Some f -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_goto (M.core_of s) (S o)) (M.mu s + 1) true

verdicts.name: pu_hCERTIFY_fail
verdicts.statement: forall o Ph s, subcode (o, pu_hCERTIFY o) (1, Ph) -> hpc s = o -> herr s = false -> M.chan (M.core_of s) = None -> hrun_prog 1 Ph s = M.mkst (M.pu_trap (M.core_of s)) (M.mu s + 1) (M.cert s)

verdicts.name: pu_hPAY_pass

verdicts.statement: forall (Mp : list E.minsky) K s, M.err (M.core_of s) = false -> (E.mstep Mp (sm_win K (M.core_of s)) = None <-> M.next_instr (map (sm_mk K) Mp) (M.core_of s) = None) /\ (forall y, E.mstep Mp (sm_win K (M.core_of s)) = Some y -> sm_win K (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) = y /\ (forall q, q <> K -> q <> S K -> M.vals (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) q = M.vals (M.core_of s) q) /\ (forall q, q <> K -> q <> S K -> M.vers (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) q = M.vers (M.core_of s) q) /\ M.facts (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) = M.facts (M.core_of s) /\ M.chan (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) = M.chan (M.core_of s) /\ M.err (M.core_of (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s)) = false /\ M.mu (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s) = M.mu s /\ M.cert (step (map (sm_mk K) Mp) s) = M.cert s)

verdicts.name: sm_mk_run

verdicts.name: sm_rice_phase1

verdicts.name: push_distribution

verdicts.name: push_support

verdicts.name: rsum_permutation

verdicts.name: rsum_map

verdicts.name: push_injective_at
verdicts.statement: forall (all : list A) (f : A -> A) (p : A -> R), NoDup all -> (forall a, In a all) -> (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall x, push all f p (f x) = p x

verdicts.name: step_entropy_invariant_if_injective

verdicts.name: rsum_select

verdicts.name: rsum_nonneg_in

verdicts.name: push_ge_point

verdicts.name: push_ge_two

verdicts.name: push_entropy_as_point_sum
verdicts.statement: forall (all : list A) (f : A -> A) (p : A -> R), NoDup all -> (forall a, In a all) -> (forall a, 0 <= p a) -> entropy all (push all f p) = rsum all (fun x => if Rlt_dec 0 (p x) then - (p x * log2 (push all f p (f x))) else 0)

verdicts.name: entropy_drop_as_point_sum

verdicts.name: entropy_drop_term_nonneg

verdicts.name: entropy_drop_nonneg

verdicts.name: nec_s_exact_host_iff

verdicts.name: nec_s_U_floor_three_attained

verdicts.name: nec_s_grun_mu_step

verdicts.name: nec_s_U_sim_bound_attained

verdicts.name: nec_s_halting_decidable_classically

verdicts.name: nec_s_separation_any_clean_start

verdicts.name: nec_s_same_ledger_different_flag

verdicts.name: nec_s_no_flag_oracle_even_with_ledger

verdicts.name: nec_s_cert_oracle_iff

verdicts.name: nec_s_clean_commit_oracle_iff_trapped

verdicts.name: nec_s_only_order_certifies

verdicts.name: nec_s_commit_refuses_true_stale

verdicts.name: nec_s_versioned_refuses

verdicts.name: nec_s_versionless_unsound

verdicts.name: nec_s_simulation_needs_trap_down

verdicts.name: nec_s_toll_without_permanence
verdicts.statement: (forall s i, cert s = false -> cert (nec_s_exec_drop s i) = true -> i = CERTIFY /\ certify_ok (core_of s) = true /\ cost i >= 1) /\ (forall tr s, cert s = false -> cert (nec_s_run_drop tr s) = true -> total_cost tr >= 1) /\ (forall s i, mu (nec_s_exec_drop s i) = mu s + cost i) /\ ~ (forall s i, cert s = true -> cert (nec_s_exec_drop s i) = true)

verdicts.name: nec_s_table_bound_attained
verdicts.statement: let k := core_of (run (repeat (CHECK nec_s_G CA) 16) (start 0 0)) in length (facts k) = 16 /\ err k = false /\ err (cexec k (CHECK nec_s_G CA)) = true /\ facts (cexec k (CHECK nec_s_G CA)) = facts k

verdicts.name: nec_s_refused_from_any_flag_down_state

verdicts.name: nec_s_refused_any_continuation

verdicts.name: zap_run_some

verdicts.name: nec_t_clean_runs_need_three_moves

verdicts.name: nec_t_ledgerless_meets_all_but_ledger
verdicts.statement: forall M (I : thiele_interface M), thiele_complete_with I -> let J := with_ledger I (fun _ => 0) in universal_base_clause J /\ earned_record_clause J /\ non_vacuity_clause J /\ (forall m, m_cost M m = record_move J m) /\ ~ exact_toll_clause J /\ exists a b tr, ti_clean J (load J a b) /\ m_record M (run M tr (load J a b)) = true /\ ti_ledger J (run M tr (load J a b)) < ti_ledger J (load J a b) + 3

verdicts.name: nec_t_unsound_check_meets_all_but_soundness
verdicts.statement: forall M (I : thiele_interface M), thiele_complete_with I -> let J := with_check I (fun _ _ => true) in universal_base_clause J /\ exact_toll_clause J /\ non_vacuity_clause J /\ (forall s0 tr, ti_clean J s0 -> m_record M (run M tr s0) = true -> earned_chain J s0 tr) /\ (forall s, ti_clean J s -> m_record M s = false) /\ (forall c s s', ti_same J c s s' -> ti_meaning J c s -> ti_meaning J c s') /\ ~ (forall s c, ti_check J s c = true -> ti_meaning J c s) /\ ~ (exists a b chk c, ti_kind J chk = KCheck c /\ ti_check J (load J a b) c = false /\ ~ ti_meaning J c (load J a b))

verdicts.name: nec_t_same_true_meets_all_but_respect

verdicts.name: ax_rsum_flat_map

verdicts.name: ax_rsum_map

verdicts.name: ax_nb_pos

verdicts.name: ax_mb_pos

verdicts.name: ax_mb_le_1
verdicts.statement: forall k, ax_mb k <= 1

verdicts.name: ax_pb_in

verdicts.name: ax_blk_sum

verdicts.name: ax_block_mass_n

verdicts.name: ax_pb_nonneg

verdicts.name: ax_pow2_quad

verdicts.name: ax_block_loss_unbounded

verdicts.name: ax_block_no_toll

verdicts.name: ax_toll_covers_landauer_minimum
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (P : BPre A) (X : AxSys A P) (eq_dec : forall a b : ax_state A P X, {a = b} + {a <> b}) (i : ax_instr A P X) (p : ax_state A P X -> R) (ys : list (ax_state A P X)) (pre : ax_state A P X -> list (ax_state A P X)) (kT : R), ax_compression_priced A P X eq_dec -> 0 <= kT -> (forall x, 0 <= p x) -> ax_lists_spots A P X i ys pre -> ax_rsum (ax_landauer_minimum kT (ax_state A P X) p) (map pre ys) <= (kT * ln 2 * INR (ax_cost A P X i)) * ax_mass (ax_state A P X) p (map pre ys)

verdicts.name: ax_nec_respect_same

verdicts.name: tc2_pick_spec

verdicts.name: fs_par_lt

verdicts.name: fs_par_spec

verdicts.name: fs_par_add2

verdicts.name: fs_par_eq

verdicts.name: fs_yrep_ge

verdicts.name: fs_yrep_le

verdicts.name: fs_yrep_mod

verdicts.name: fo_s_0

verdicts.name: fo_d_0

verdicts.name: fo_S_some

verdicts.name: fo_S_none
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 n, fs_nx M (fo_s M s0 n) = None -> fo_s M s0 (S n) = fo_s M s0 n /\ fo_d M s0 (S n) = fo_d M s0 n

verdicts.name: fs_corr
verdicts.statement: forall M q0 s0 v n, (forall t, t < n -> (Z.of_nat (am_B M) <= Z.of_nat v + fo_d M (fs_start M q0 s0 v) t)%Z) -> exists y, Z.of_nat y = (Z.of_nat v + fo_d M (fs_start M q0 s0 v) n)%Z /\ am_run M n (q0, s0, v) = (fq M (fo_s M (fs_start M q0 s0 v) n), fx M (fo_s M (fs_start M q0 s0 v) n), y) /\ fp M (fo_s M (fs_start M q0 s0 v) n) = fs_par y

verdicts.name: fo_add

verdicts.name: fs_nx_bound
verdicts.statement: forall M s s' dy, fs_nx M s = Some (s', dy) -> (fx M s' = fx M s \/ fx M s' = S (fx M s) \/ S (fx M s') = fx M s) /\ (-1 <= dy <= 1)%Z /\ fp M s' < 2

verdicts.name: fo_step
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 t, (fx M (fo_s M s0 (S t)) = fx M (fo_s M s0 t) \/ fx M (fo_s M s0 (S t)) = S (fx M (fo_s M s0 t)) \/ S (fx M (fo_s M s0 (S t))) = fx M (fo_s M s0 t)) /\ (-1 <= fo_d M s0 (S t) - fo_d M s0 t <= 1)%Z

verdicts.name: fo_x_le
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 t, fx M (fo_s M s0 t) <= fx M s0 + t

verdicts.name: fo_d_bound
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 t, (- Z.of_nat t <= fo_d M s0 t <= Z.of_nat t)%Z

verdicts.name: fo_p_lt
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 t, fp M s0 < 2 -> fp M (fo_s M s0 t) < 2

verdicts.name: fs_nx_q
verdicts.statement: forall M s s' dy, fs_nx M s = Some (s', dy) -> In (fq M s) (am_lq M) -> In (fq M s') (am_lq M)

verdicts.name: fo_q_in
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 t, In (fq M s0) (am_lq M) -> In (fq M (fo_s M s0 t)) (am_lq M)

verdicts.name: fo_par
verdicts.statement: forall M s0 n, fp M s0 < 2 -> exists k : Z, Z.of_nat (fp M (fo_s M s0 n)) = (Z.of_nat (fp M s0) + fo_d M s0 n + 2 * k)%Z

verdicts.name: fs_nx_sh
verdicts.statement: forall M d q x p, am_B M <= x -> fs_nx M (q, x + 2 * d, p) = match fs_nx M (q, x, p) with Some (s', dy) => Some (fs_shA M (2 * d) s', dy) | None => None end

verdicts.name: fo_sh

verdicts.name: fx_shA

verdicts.name: fq_shA

verdicts.name: fp_shA

verdicts.name: fs_nx_shs

verdicts.name: fs_cfg_eq
verdicts.statement: forall M (x y : am_Q M * nat * nat), {x = y} + {x <> y}

verdicts.name: orb_pump_asc
verdicts.statement: forall i p g2, 0 < p -> Sx (i + p) = fs_shA M (2 * g2) (Sx i) -> (forall t, i <= t -> t <= i + p -> Bt <= Xx t) -> (forall t, t <= i + p -> fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None) -> forall t, i <= t -> Bt <= Xx t /\ fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None /\ Sx (t + p) = fs_shA M (2 * g2) (Sx t) /\ Dx (t + p) = (Dx t + (Dx (i + p) - Dx i))%Z

verdicts.name: fs_shA_of
verdicts.statement: forall M d (s s' : fcfg M), fq M s = fq M s' -> fp M s = fp M s' -> fx M s = fx M s' + 2 * d -> s = fs_shA M (2 * d) s'

verdicts.name: orb_x_from
verdicts.statement: forall s k, Xx (s + k) <= Xx s + k

verdicts.name: orb_pump_desc
verdicts.statement: forall i p g2 R, 0 < p -> 0 < g2 -> Sx i = fs_shA M (2 * g2) (Sx (i + p)) -> (forall t, i <= t -> t <= i + (R + 1) * p -> Bt <= Xx t) -> forall r, r <= R -> fq M (Sx (i + r * p)) = fq M (Sx i) /\ fp M (Sx (i + r * p)) = fp M (Sx i) /\ Xx (i + r * p) + 2 * (r * g2) = Xx i

verdicts.name: orb_no_desc

verdicts.name: orb_entry
verdicts.statement: forall K s, (forall k, k <= K -> Bt <= Xx (s + k)) -> exists s', s' <= s /\ Xx s' = Bt /\ (forall k, k <= K -> Bt <= Xx (s' + k))

verdicts.name: in01

verdicts.name: fs_Ax_in

verdicts.name: orb_win
verdicts.statement: forall s, exists r1 r2, r1 < r2 /\ r2 <= K1 /\ fs_Ax (s + r1) = fs_Ax (s + r2)

verdicts.name: orb_stretch
verdicts.statement: forall s, (forall k, k <= K2 -> Bt <= Xx (s + k)) -> (forall t, t <= s + K2 -> fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None) -> exists i p g2 d, fs_pump i p g2 d

verdicts.name: fs_shA_0
verdicts.statement: forall (s : fcfg M), fs_shA M (2 * 0) s = s

verdicts.name: fs_Sx_in_lS
verdicts.statement: forall t, Xx t < Bt -> In (Sx t) fs_lS

verdicts.name: orb_periodic
verdicts.statement: forall i p, 0 < p -> Sx (i + p) = Sx i -> (forall t, t < i + p -> fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None) -> forall t, i <= t -> Sx (t + p) = Sx t /\ Dx (t + p) = (Dx t + (Dx (i + p) - Dx i))%Z /\ fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None

verdicts.name: orb_class
verdicts.statement: (exists H, fs_nx M (Sx H) = None /\ forall t, t < H -> fs_nx M (Sx t) <> None) \/ (exists i p g2 d, fs_pump i p g2 d)

verdicts.name: real_none
verdicts.statement: forall M q x y p, am_nx M q x (fs_yrep M p) = None -> am_B M <= y -> fs_par y = p -> p < 2 -> am_nx M q x y = None

verdicts.name: real_some
verdicts.statement: forall M q x y p q' x' y', am_nx M q x (fs_yrep M p) = Some (q', x', y') -> am_B M <= y -> fs_par y = p -> p < 2 -> am_nx M q x y <> None

verdicts.name: st_fp_unique
verdicts.statement: forall M q0 s0 v T T' q x q' x', st_fp M q0 s0 v T q x -> st_fp M q0 s0 v T' q' x' -> T = T' /\ q = q' /\ x = x'

verdicts.name: st_any_mono

verdicts.name: fs_shA_add

verdicts.name: fo_d_diff

verdicts.name: pump_D

verdicts.name: pump_S

verdicts.name: fs_nx_some_inv

verdicts.name: st_leaf_of_halt

verdicts.name: st_nh_of_pump

verdicts.name: st_next_of_pump

verdicts.name: ch_stage_le

verdicts.name: sl_both
verdicts.statement: forall M, exists th Xl, am_B M <= th /\ (forall q0 s0 pi, In q0 (am_lq M) -> s0 < am_B M -> pi < 2 -> st_any M q0 s0 pi th Xl (length (fs_lA M))) /\ (forall q0 s0 pi, In q0 (am_lq M) -> s0 < am_B M -> pi < 2 -> st_any (am_swp M) q0 s0 pi th Xl (length (fs_lA M)))

verdicts.name: st_next_iter
verdicts.statement: forall M q0 s0 pi th p g2 m2, (forall v, th <= v -> fs_par v = pi -> (exists T q x, st_fp M q0 s0 v T q x) /\ (forall T q x, st_fp M q0 s0 v T q x -> st_fp M q0 s0 (v + 2 * m2) (T + p) q (x + 2 * g2))) -> forall v T q x j, th <= v -> fs_par v = pi -> st_fp M q0 s0 v T q x -> st_fp M q0 s0 (v + 2 * m2 * j) (T + p * j) q (x + 2 * g2 * j)

verdicts.name: iface_of_any

verdicts.name: am_shA_0

verdicts.name: am_shB_0

verdicts.name: am_sw_inj

verdicts.name: iface_A
verdicts.statement: forall M th Xl K, am_B M <= th -> (forall q0 s0 pi, In q0 (am_lq M) -> s0 < am_B M -> pi < 2 -> st_any (am_swp M) q0 s0 pi th Xl K) -> forall k, am_b M k < am_B M -> In (am_q M k) (am_lq M) -> th <= am_a M k -> ifA_leaf M k \/ ifA_next M k K \/ ifA_bdd M k th \/ ifA_nh M k

verdicts.name: good_exists

verdicts.name: coprime_mul

verdicts.name: ch_prod_coprime

verdicts.name: am_no_multiplier

verdicts.name: tc2_run_add

verdicts.name: tc2_after_halt

verdicts.name: tc2_collision

verdicts.name: tc2_pe_step
verdicts.statement: forall P k k', tc2_pure P -> tc2_pe k k' -> tc2_pe (E.core_step P k) (E.core_step P k')

verdicts.name: tc2_pe_run

verdicts.name: tc2_collision_pure

verdicts.name: tc2_err_false

verdicts.name: tc2_shift_step
verdicts.statement: forall P d k, tc2_pure P -> ~ tc2_zt P k -> E.core_step P (tc2_shift d k) = tc2_shift d (E.core_step P k)

verdicts.name: tc2_shift_run
verdicts.statement: forall n P d s s', tc2_pure P -> E.core_of s' = tc2_shift d (E.core_of s) -> (forall j, j < n -> ~ tc2_zt P (E.core_of (E.run_prog j P s))) -> E.core_of (E.run_prog n P s') = tc2_shift d (E.core_of (E.run_prog n P s))

verdicts.name: tc2_start_shift
verdicts.statement: forall x d, E.core_of (E.start (x + d) 0) = tc2_shift d (E.core_of (E.start x 0))

verdicts.name: tc2_safe_mono
verdicts.statement: forall P x n m, tc2_safe P x n -> m <= n -> tc2_safe P x m

verdicts.name: tc2_shifted_run
verdicts.statement: forall P x d n, tc2_pure P -> tc2_safe P x n -> E.core_of (E.run_prog n P (E.start (x + d) 0)) = tc2_shift d (E.core_of (E.run_prog n P (E.start x 0)))

verdicts.name: tc2_slaving
verdicts.statement: forall P t x n m, tc2_pure P -> tc2_adds P t -> tc2_safe P x n -> tc2_safe P x m -> E.pc (E.core_of (E.run_prog n P (E.start x 0))) = E.pc (E.core_of (E.run_prog m P (E.start x 0))) -> E.cb (E.core_of (E.run_prog n P (E.start x 0))) = E.cb (E.core_of (E.run_prog m P (E.start x 0))) -> E.ca (E.core_of (E.run_prog n P (E.start x 0))) = E.ca (E.core_of (E.run_prog m P (E.start x 0)))

verdicts.name: tc2_fa_eqb_true
verdicts.statement: forall x y, tc2_fa_eqb x y = true <-> x = y

verdicts.name: tc2_cl_in
verdicts.statement: forall n j, 1 <= j -> j <= n -> tc2_cl n j = j

verdicts.name: tc2_cl_range
verdicts.statement: forall n j, 1 <= tc2_cl n j /\ tc2_cl n j <= S n

verdicts.name: tc2_cl_out
verdicts.statement: forall n j, ~ (1 <= j /\ j <= n) -> tc2_cl n j = S n

verdicts.name: tc2_inv_start
verdicts.statement: forall P a b, tc2_inv P (E.start_core a b)

verdicts.name: tc2_next_in
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, E.next_instr P k = Some i -> E.err k = false /\ E.fetch P (E.pc k) = Some i /\ In i P /\ 1 <= E.pc k /\ E.pc k <= length P /\ i <> E.HALT

verdicts.name: tc2_fetch_cl
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) j, E.fetch P (tc2_cl (length P) j) = E.fetch P j

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_write
verdicts.statement: forall P k c n j, tc2_inv P k -> tc2_abs P (E.write k c n j) = (tc2_cl (length P) j, E.err k, tc2_chb k, tc2_bump c (map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k)))

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_goto
verdicts.statement: forall P k j, tc2_abs P (E.goto k j) = (tc2_cl (length P) j, E.err k, tc2_chb k, map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k))

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_trap
verdicts.statement: forall P k, tc2_abs P (E.trap k) = (tc2_cl (length P) (E.pc k), true, tc2_chb k, map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k))

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_record
verdicts.statement: forall P k p c, tc2_abs P (E.record_fact k (E.claim k p c)) = (tc2_cl (length P) (S (E.pc k)), E.err k, tc2_chb k, (p, c, true) :: map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k))

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_commit
verdicts.statement: forall P k p c, tc2_abs P (E.commit_to k (E.claim k p c)) = (tc2_cl (length P) (S (E.pc k)), E.err k, true, map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k))

verdicts.name: tc2_existsb_commit
verdicts.statement: forall k p c fs, existsb (fun f => tc2_fa_eqb f (p, c, true)) (map (tc2_absf k) fs) = existsb (E.fact_eqb (E.claim k p c)) fs

verdicts.name: tc2_facts_write
verdicts.statement: forall k c n j, E.facts (E.write k c n j) = E.facts k

verdicts.name: tc2_inv_cexec
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, tc2_inv P k -> E.next_instr P k = Some i -> tc2_inv P (E.cexec k i)

verdicts.name: tc2_inv_step
verdicts.statement: forall P k, tc2_inv P k -> tc2_inv P (E.core_step P k)

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_none
verdicts.statement: forall P k, E.next_instr P k = None -> tc2_nx P (tc2_abs P k) (E.ca k) (E.cb k) = None

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_some
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, E.next_instr P k = Some i -> tc2_nx P (tc2_abs P k) (E.ca k) (E.cb k) = tc2_nxi (length P) i (E.pc k) false (tc2_chb k) (map (tc2_absf k) (E.facts k)) (E.ca k) (E.cb k)

verdicts.name: tc2_sim_step
verdicts.statement: forall P k, tc2_inv P k -> (tc2_abs P (E.core_step P k), E.ca (E.core_step P k), E.cb (E.core_step P k)) = tc2_stp P (tc2_abs P k, E.ca k, E.cb k)

verdicts.name: tc2_lu_in
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} n (al : list X) l, length l <= n -> (forall x, In x l -> In x al) -> In l (tc2_lu n al)

verdicts.name: tc2_flat_len
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} (L : list (list X)) (al : list X), length (flat_map (fun x => map (cons x) L) al) = length al * length L

verdicts.name: tc2_pw_pos
verdicts.statement: forall b e, 1 <= b -> 1 <= tc2_pw b e

verdicts.name: tc2_lu_len
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} n (al : list X), length (tc2_lu n al) <= tc2_pw (S (length al)) n

verdicts.name: tc2_thr_ge
verdicts.statement: forall P n c, In (E.CHECK (E.PGe n) c) P -> n <= tc2_thr P

verdicts.name: tc2_fal_in
verdicts.statement: forall P p c b, In (p, c, b) (tc2_fal P) <-> In (E.CHECK p c) P

verdicts.name: tc2_flat_len2
verdicts.statement: forall {A B : Type} (f : A -> list B) (l : list A), (forall x, length (f x) <= 2) -> length (flat_map f l) <= 2 * length l

verdicts.name: tc2_fal_len
verdicts.statement: forall P, length (tc2_fal P) <= 2 * length P

verdicts.name: tc2_lu_ok
verdicts.statement: forall {X : Type} n (al : list X) l, In l (tc2_lu n al) -> length l <= n /\ forall x, In x l -> In x al

verdicts.name: tc2_lq_in
verdicts.statement: forall P q, In q (tc2_lq P) <-> tc2_okq P q

verdicts.name: tc2_bump_ok
verdicts.statement: forall P c fl, (forall x, In x fl -> In (E.CHECK (fst (fst x)) (snd (fst x))) P) -> length (tc2_bump c fl) = length fl /\ forall x, In x (tc2_bump c fl) -> In (E.CHECK (fst (fst x)) (snd (fst x))) P

verdicts.name: tc2_fetch_in
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list E.instr) n i, E.fetch P n = Some i -> In i P /\ 1 <= n /\ n <= length P

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_okq
verdicts.statement: forall P q a b q' a' b', tc2_okq P q -> tc2_nx P q a b = Some (q', a', b') -> tc2_okq P q'

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_step1
verdicts.statement: forall P q a b q' a' b', tc2_nx P q a b = Some (q', a', b') -> (a' = a /\ (b' = b \/ b' = S b \/ S b' = b)) \/ (b' = b /\ (a' = S a \/ S a' = a))

verdicts.name: tc2_even_shift
verdicts.statement: forall a d, Nat.even (a + 2 * d) = Nat.even a

verdicts.name: tc2_eval_shift
verdicts.statement: forall P p c a d, In (E.CHECK p c) P -> S (tc2_thr P) <= a -> E.eval p (a + 2 * d) = E.eval p a

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_tameA
verdicts.statement: forall P q a b d, S (tc2_thr P) <= a -> tc2_nx P q (a + 2 * d) b = match tc2_nx P q a b with Some (q', a', b') => Some (q', a' + 2 * d, b') | None => None end

verdicts.name: tc2_nx_tameB
verdicts.statement: forall P q a b d, S (tc2_thr P) <= b -> tc2_nx P q a (b + 2 * d) = match tc2_nx P q a b with Some (q', a', b') => Some (q', a', b' + 2 * d) | None => None end

verdicts.name: tc2_am_stp
verdicts.statement: forall P x, am_stp (tc2_am_of P) x = tc2_stp P x

verdicts.name: tc2_sim_run
verdicts.statement: forall P n k, tc2_inv P k -> (tc2_abs P (E.core_run n P k), E.ca (E.core_run n P k), E.cb (E.core_run n P k)) = am_run (tc2_am_of P) n (tc2_abs P k, E.ca k, E.cb k)

verdicts.name: tc2_inv_run
verdicts.statement: forall P n k, tc2_inv P k -> tc2_inv P (E.core_run n P k)

verdicts.name: tc2_nxi_some
verdicts.statement: forall n i pc er ch fl a b, i <> E.HALT -> tc2_nxi n i pc er ch fl a b <> None

verdicts.name: tc2_halted_iff
verdicts.statement: forall P k, tc2_nx P (tc2_abs P k) (E.ca k) (E.cb k) = None <-> E.next_instr P k = None

verdicts.name: tc2_abs_start
verdicts.statement: forall P x, tc2_abs P (E.start_core x 0) = tc2_q0 P

verdicts.name: tc2_pf_iff
verdicts.statement: forall P x y, tc2_pf P x y <-> exists n, am_hlt (tc2_am_of P) (am_run (tc2_am_of P) n (tc2_q0 P, x, 0)) /\ am_a (tc2_am_of P) (am_run (tc2_am_of P) n (tc2_q0 P, x, 0)) = y

verdicts.name: tc2_fact_pos
verdicts.statement: forall n, 1 <= tc2_fact n

verdicts.name: tc2_fact_div
verdicts.statement: forall N k, 1 <= k -> k <= N -> Nat.divide k (tc2_fact N)

verdicts.name: tc2_fact_coprime
verdicts.statement: forall N k, 1 <= k -> k <= N -> Nat.gcd (tc2_fact N + 1) k = 1

verdicts.name: tc2_pw_mono
verdicts.statement: forall a b e, a <= b -> tc2_pw a e <= tc2_pw b e

verdicts.name: tc2_lq_len
verdicts.statement: forall P, length (tc2_lq P) <= tc2_Nb (length P)

verdicts.name: tc2_q0_in
verdicts.statement: forall P, In (tc2_q0 P) (tc2_lq P)

verdicts.name: tc2_no_mult
verdicts.statement: forall P : list E.instr, ~ (forall x, tc2_pf P x (tc2_c (length P) * x))

verdicts.name: tc_rj_in
verdicts.statement: forall off len j, 1 <= j <= len -> tc_rj off len j = j + off

verdicts.name: tc_rj_out
verdicts.statement: forall off len j, ~ (1 <= j <= len) -> tc_rj off len j = S (len + off)

verdicts.name: tc_rj_S
verdicts.statement: forall off len p, 1 <= p <= len -> tc_rj off len (S p) = S (p + off)

verdicts.name: tc_grun_succ
verdicts.statement: forall n P s, E.run_prog (S n) P s = E.run_prog n P (E.step P s)

verdicts.name: tc_grun_add
verdicts.statement: forall a b P s, E.run_prog (a + b) P s = E.run_prog b P (E.run_prog a P s)

verdicts.name: tc_ghalted_after
verdicts.statement: forall a b P s, a <= b -> E.halted P (E.core_of (E.run_prog a P s)) -> E.run_prog b P s = E.run_prog a P s

verdicts.name: tc_greloc_length
verdicts.statement: forall off B, length (tc_greloc off B) = length B

verdicts.name: tc_gembeds_app
verdicts.statement: forall A B C, tc_gembeds (A ++ tc_greloc (length A) B ++ C) B (length A)

verdicts.name: tc_gfetch_range
verdicts.statement: forall (B : list E.instr) p i, E.fetch B p = Some i -> 1 <= p <= length B

verdicts.name: tc_gfetch_out
verdicts.statement: forall (B : list E.instr) p, ~ (1 <= p <= length B) -> E.fetch B p = None

verdicts.name: tc_eqb_add
verdicts.statement: forall v w x, Nat.eqb (v + x) (w + x) = Nat.eqb v w

verdicts.name: tc_fsh_eqb
verdicts.statement: forall da db f g, E.fact_eqb (tc_fsh da db f) (tc_fsh da db g) = E.fact_eqb f g

verdicts.name: tc_existsb_fsh
verdicts.statement: forall da db f l, existsb (E.fact_eqb (tc_fsh da db f)) (map (tc_fsh da db) l) = existsb (E.fact_eqb f) l

verdicts.name: tc_fsh_zero
verdicts.statement: forall l, map (tc_fsh 0 0) l = l

verdicts.name: tc_fsh_opt_zero
verdicts.statement: forall o, option_map (tc_fsh 0 0) o = o

verdicts.name: tc_gnext_some
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, E.next_instr P k = Some i -> E.err k = false /\ E.fetch P (E.pc k) = Some i /\ i <> E.HALT

verdicts.name: tc_gnext_intro
verdicts.statement: forall P k i, E.err k = false -> E.fetch P (E.pc k) = Some i -> i <> E.HALT -> E.next_instr P k = Some i

verdicts.name: tc_gri_halt
verdicts.statement: forall off len i, tc_gri off len i = E.HALT <-> i = E.HALT

verdicts.name: tc_gcrel_val
verdicts.statement: forall off len da db k k' c, tc_gcrel off len da db k k' -> E.val k c = E.val k' c

verdicts.name: tc_gcrel_claim
verdicts.statement: forall off len da db k k' p c, tc_gcrel off len da db k k' -> E.claim k' p c = tc_fsh da db (E.claim k p c)

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_cstep
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db k k' i, tc_gembeds Q B off -> tc_gcrel off (length B) da db k k' -> E.next_instr B k = Some i -> E.next_instr Q k' = Some (tc_gri off (length B) i) /\ tc_gcrel off (length B) da db (E.cexec k i) (E.cexec k' (tc_gri off (length B) i))

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_step
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db s s' i, tc_gembeds Q B off -> tc_gsrel off (length B) da db s s' -> E.next_instr B (E.core_of s) = Some i -> E.next_instr Q (E.core_of s') = Some (tc_gri off (length B) i) /\ tc_gsrel off (length B) da db (E.step B s) (E.step Q s')

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_run_mid
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db, tc_gembeds Q B off -> forall n s s', tc_gsrel off (length B) da db s s' -> (forall m, m < n -> E.next_instr B (E.core_of (E.run_prog m B s)) <> None) -> tc_gsrel off (length B) da db (E.run_prog n B s) (E.run_prog n Q s')

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_not_halted
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db s s', tc_gembeds Q B off -> tc_gsrel off (length B) da db s s' -> E.next_instr B (E.core_of s) <> None -> E.next_instr Q (E.core_of s') <> None

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_halted
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db k k', tc_gembeds Q B off -> length Q = off + length B -> tc_gcrel off (length B) da db k k' -> E.halted B k -> E.halted Q k'

verdicts.name: tc_gblock_run_final
verdicts.statement: forall Q B off da db, tc_gembeds Q B off -> length Q = off + length B -> forall n s s', tc_gsrel off (length B) da db s s' -> tc_gsrel off (length B) da db (E.run_prog n B s) (E.run_prog n Q s')

verdicts.name: tc_gplain_exec
verdicts.statement: forall s i, (exists c, i = E.INC c) \/ (exists c j, i = E.DEC c j) -> E.facts (E.core_of (E.exec s i)) = E.facts (E.core_of s) /\ E.chan (E.core_of (E.exec s i)) = E.chan (E.core_of s) /\ E.err (E.core_of (E.exec s i)) = E.err (E.core_of s) /\ E.mu (E.exec s i) = E.mu s /\ E.cert (E.exec s i) = E.cert s

verdicts.name: tc_compile_run
verdicts.statement: forall (Mp : list E.minsky) n s, E.err (E.core_of s) = false -> E.window (E.core_of (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s)) = E.mrun n Mp (E.window (E.core_of s)) /\ E.facts (E.core_of (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s)) = E.facts (E.core_of s) /\ E.chan (E.core_of (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s)) = E.chan (E.core_of s) /\ E.err (E.core_of (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s)) = false /\ E.mu (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s) = E.mu s /\ E.cert (E.run_prog n (E.compile Mp) s) = E.cert s

verdicts.name: tc_gfetch_app_left
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : list E.instr) n, n <= length A -> E.fetch (A ++ B) n = E.fetch A n

verdicts.name: tc_gfetch_app_right
verdicts.statement: forall (A C : list E.instr) p, E.fetch (A ++ C) (length A + S p) = E.fetch C (S p)

verdicts.name: tc_vec2
verdicts.statement: forall v : vec nat 2, v = tc_tovec (v#>pos1) (v#>pos0)

verdicts.name: tc_vec2_ex
verdicts.statement: forall v : vec nat 2, exists a b, v = tc_tovec a b

verdicts.name: tc_ofvec_tovec
verdicts.statement: forall a b, tc_ofvec (tc_tovec a b) = (a, b)

verdicts.name: tc_ofvec_inj
verdicts.statement: forall v w, tc_ofvec v = tc_ofvec w -> v = w

verdicts.name: tc_mstep_fetch
verdicts.statement: forall M x m, E.fetch M (fst x) = Some m -> E.mstep M x = Some (tc_exec m x)

verdicts.name: tc_mstep_none
verdicts.statement: forall M x, E.fetch M (fst x) = None -> E.mstep M x = None

verdicts.name: tc_mstep_none_iff
verdicts.statement: forall M x, E.mstep M x = None <-> E.fetch M (fst x) = None

verdicts.name: tc_ctr_0
verdicts.statement: tc_ctr (pos0 : pos 2) = E.CB

verdicts.name: tc_ctr_1
verdicts.statement: tc_ctr (pos1 : pos 2) = E.CA

verdicts.name: tc_inst_forward
verdicts.statement: forall (rho : mm_instr (pos 2)) i v j w, mma_sss rho (i, v) (j, w) -> (j, tc_ofvec w) = tc_exec (tc_conv rho) (i, tc_ofvec v)

verdicts.name: tc_inst_back
verdicts.statement: forall (rho : mm_instr (pos 2)) i v j w, (j, tc_ofvec w) = tc_exec (tc_conv rho) (i, tc_ofvec v) -> mma_sss rho (i, v) (j, w)

verdicts.name: tc_fetch_conv
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) i, E.fetch (tc_P P) i = option_map tc_conv (E.fetch P i)

verdicts.name: tc_step_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) i v j w, sss_step (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) (i, v) (j, w) <-> E.mstep (tc_P P) (i, tc_ofvec v) = Some (j, tc_ofvec w)

verdicts.name: tc_steps_mrun
verdicts.statement: forall M n c c', tc_steps M n c c' -> E.mrun n M c = c'

verdicts.name: tc_mrun_steps
verdicts.statement: forall M n c c', E.mrun n M c = c' -> E.mstep M c' = None -> exists m, m <= n /\ tc_steps M m c c'

verdicts.name: tc_steps_app
verdicts.statement: forall M m n c c' c'', tc_steps M m c c' -> tc_steps M n c' c'' -> tc_steps M (m + n) c c''

verdicts.name: tc_steps_fwd
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) n st st', sss_steps (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) n st st' -> tc_steps (tc_P P) n (fst st, tc_ofvec (snd st)) (fst st', tc_ofvec (snd st'))

verdicts.name: tc_steps_bwd
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) n c c', tc_steps (tc_P P) n c c' -> forall i v j w, c = (i, tc_ofvec v) -> c' = (j, tc_ofvec w) -> sss_steps (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) n (i, v) (j, w)

verdicts.name: tc_steps_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) n i v j w, sss_steps (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) n (i, v) (j, w) <-> tc_steps (tc_P P) n (i, tc_ofvec v) (j, tc_ofvec w)

verdicts.name: tc_fetch_none_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) j, E.fetch (tc_P P) j = None <-> out_code j (1, P)

verdicts.name: tc_output_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) i v j w, sss_output (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) (i, v) (j, w) <-> exists n, tc_steps (tc_P P) n (i, tc_ofvec v) (j, tc_ofvec w) /\ E.mstep (tc_P P) (j, tc_ofvec w) = None

verdicts.name: tc_terminates_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) i v, sss_terminates (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) (i, v) <-> exists n c', tc_steps (tc_P P) n (i, tc_ofvec v) c' /\ E.mstep (tc_P P) c' = None

verdicts.name: tc_nonterm_never_stops
verdicts.statement: forall (P : list (mm_instr (pos 2))) i v, ~ sss_terminates (@mma_sss 2) (1, P) (i, v) -> forall n, E.mstep (tc_P P) (E.mrun n (tc_P P) (i, tc_ofvec v)) <> None

verdicts.name: tc_AB

verdicts.name: lift_model_independence
verdicts.statement: (forall M0 (U : T.universal_base M0) cap, 0 < cap -> T.thiele_complete (lift_machine M0 (lift_window_lang M0 U) cap)) /\ (forall (A : Type) (P : BPre A) (AX : lift_axis P) M0 (U : T.universal_base M0) cap (pts : nat -> A) k0, 0 < cap -> ~ bp_le P (pts k0) (lift_la_floor AX) -> ax_thiele_complete (lift_lax_machine AX M0 (lift_window_lang_pts M0 U) cap (fun ck => pts (snd ck)))) /\ (forall M, T.thiele_complete M -> exists I : T.thiele_interface M, T.thiele_complete_with I /\ inhabited (T.universal_base (lift_reduct M I))) /\ (forall M0 (U : T.universal_base M0), ~ lift_finitely_branching M0) /\ (forall M0 LG cap, lift_finitely_branching M0 -> ~ T.thiele_complete (lift_machine M0 LG cap)) /\ (forall M0 LG cap, lift_stateless M0 -> ~ T.thiele_complete (lift_machine M0 LG cap)) /\ (inhabited (T.universal_base lift_ex_machine) /\ lift_in_all_models lift_ex_rel /\ T.thiele_complete (lift_machine lift_ex_machine (lift_window_lang lift_ex_machine lift_ex_base) 16) /\ T.thiele_complete (lift_machine lift_ram_machine (lift_window_lang lift_ram_machine lift_ram_base) 16)) /\ (forall (Mp : presented_machine) (pc : cg_presentation Mp) s0, lift_runs_on_U pc s0) /\ (forall P x, lift_oc_halts P x \/ ~ lift_oc_halts P x) /\ undecidable lift_CM_HALTING

verdicts.name: cmpz_pair_le
verdicts.statement: forall {A B} (P : BPre A) (Q : BPre B) (x y : A * B), bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) x y <-> bp_le P (fst x) (fst y) /\ bp_le Q (snd x) (snd y)

verdicts.name: cmpz_pair_antisym
verdicts.statement: forall {A B} (P : BPre A) (Q : BPre B), bp_antisym P -> bp_antisym Q -> bp_antisym (cmpz_pair_pre P Q)

verdicts.name: cmpz_lefts_app
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l1 l2 : list (X + Y)), cmpz_lefts (l1 ++ l2) = cmpz_lefts l1 ++ cmpz_lefts l2

verdicts.name: cmpz_rights_app
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l1 l2 : list (X + Y)), cmpz_rights (l1 ++ l2) = cmpz_rights l1 ++ cmpz_rights l2

verdicts.name: cmpz_lefts_split
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l : list (X + Y)) (l1 : list X) x l2, cmpz_lefts l = l1 ++ x :: l2 -> exists t1 t2, l = t1 ++ inl x :: t2 /\ cmpz_lefts t1 = l1 /\ cmpz_lefts t2 = l2

verdicts.name: cmpz_rights_split
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l : list (X + Y)) (l1 : list Y) y l2, cmpz_rights l = l1 ++ y :: l2 -> exists t1 t2, l = t1 ++ inr y :: t2 /\ cmpz_rights t1 = l1 /\ cmpz_rights t2 = l2

verdicts.name: cmpz_run_prod
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, am_run cmpz_prod tr s = (am_run M (cmpz_lefts tr) (fst s), am_run N (cmpz_rights tr) (snd s))

verdicts.name: cmpz_run_prod_fst
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, fst (am_run cmpz_prod tr s) = am_run M (cmpz_lefts tr) (fst s)

verdicts.name: cmpz_run_prod_snd
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, snd (am_run cmpz_prod tr s) = am_run N (cmpz_rights tr) (snd s)

verdicts.name: cmpz_rec_prod
verdicts.statement: forall s, am_rec cmpz_prod s = (am_rec M (fst s), am_rec N (snd s))

verdicts.name: cmpz_cost_app
verdicts.statement: forall {A' P'} (X : amachine A' P') l1 l2, cmpz_cost X (l1 ++ l2) = cmpz_cost X l1 + cmpz_cost X l2

verdicts.name: cmpz_cost_prod
verdicts.statement: forall tr, cmpz_cost cmpz_prod tr = cmpz_cost M (cmpz_lefts tr) + cmpz_cost N (cmpz_rights tr)

verdicts.name: cmpz_exits_inl_iff
verdicts.statement: forall s x, ax_exits (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod) s (inl x) <-> ax_exits (X := am_axsys M) (fst s) x

verdicts.name: cmpz_exits_inr_iff
verdicts.statement: forall s y, ax_exits (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod) s (inr y) <-> ax_exits (X := am_axsys N) (snd s) y

verdicts.name: cmpz_exit_count_prod
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, cmpz_exit_count cmpz_prod tr s = cmpz_exit_count M (cmpz_lefts tr) (fst s) + cmpz_exit_count N (cmpz_rights tr) (snd s)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_a2_if
verdicts.statement: ax_a2 (X := am_axsys M) -> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys N) -> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_a2_only_if
verdicts.statement: ax_a2 (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod) -> forall (t : am_state N) (s : am_state M), ax_a2 (X := am_axsys M)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_a2_only_if_right
verdicts.statement: ax_a2 (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod) -> forall (s : am_state M), ax_a2 (X := am_axsys N)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_a2_iff
verdicts.statement: forall (s : am_state M) (t : am_state N), ax_a2 (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod) <-> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys M) /\ ax_a2 (X := am_axsys N)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_exit_cost
verdicts.statement: ax_a2 (X := am_axsys M) -> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys N) -> forall tr s, cmpz_cost cmpz_prod tr >= cmpz_exit_count cmpz_prod tr s

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_floor
verdicts.statement: ax_a2 (X := am_axsys M) -> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys N) -> ax_floor (X := am_axsys cmpz_prod)

verdicts.name: cmpz_mapk_base_iff
verdicts.statement: forall {C D} (f : C -> D) k, cmpz_mapk f k = T.KBase <-> k = T.KBase

verdicts.name: cmpz_lub_left
verdicts.statement: forall {A B} (P : BPre A) (Q : BPre B) a1 p a2 b f, ax_is_lub P a1 p a2 -> bp_le Q f b -> ax_is_lub (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) (a1, b) (p, f) (a2, b)

verdicts.name: cmpz_lub_right
verdicts.statement: forall {A B} (P : BPre A) (Q : BPre B) b1 p b2 a f, ax_is_lub Q b1 p b2 -> bp_le P f a -> ax_is_lub (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) (a, b1) (f, p) (a, b2)

verdicts.name: cmpz_load
verdicts.statement: forall a b, ax_load cmpz_iface a b = (ax_load I1 a b, ax_load I2 a b)

verdicts.name: cmpz_record_move_inl
verdicts.statement: forall x, ax_record_move cmpz_iface (inl x) = ax_record_move I1 x

verdicts.name: cmpz_record_move_inr
verdicts.statement: forall y, ax_record_move cmpz_iface (inr y) = ax_record_move I2 y

verdicts.name: cmpz_earned_left

verdicts.name: cmpz_earned_right

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_tc
verdicts.statement: ax_tc_with cmpz_iface

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_ledger_counts
verdicts.statement: forall tr s, axi_ledger cmpz_iface (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s) = axi_ledger cmpz_iface s + ax_record_moves cmpz_iface tr

verdicts.name: cmpz_record_moves_prod
verdicts.statement: forall tr, ax_record_moves cmpz_iface tr = ax_record_moves I1 (cmpz_lefts tr) + ax_record_moves I2 (cmpz_rights tr)

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_joint_certificate
verdicts.statement: forall p q s0 tr, axi_clean cmpz_iface s0 -> ~ bp_le P p (axi_floor I1) -> ~ bp_le Q q (axi_floor I2) -> bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) (p, q) (am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0)) -> ax_record_moves cmpz_iface tr >= 6 /\ axi_ledger cmpz_iface (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0) >= axi_ledger cmpz_iface s0 + 6

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_joint_certificate_tight
verdicts.statement: forall a1 b1 a2 b2 c1 chk1 cmt1 crt1 c2 chk2 cmt2 crt2, axi_kind I1 chk1 = T.KCheck c1 -> axi_kind I1 cmt1 = T.KCommit c1 -> axi_kind I1 crt1 = T.KCertify -> axi_kind I2 chk2 = T.KCheck c2 -> axi_kind I2 cmt2 = T.KCommit c2 -> axi_kind I2 crt2 = T.KCertify -> (forall a b, bp_le P (axi_point I1 c1) (am_rec M (am_run M [chk1; cmt1; crt1] (ax_load I1 a b))) <-> axi_meaning I1 c1 (ax_load I1 a b)) -> (forall a b, bp_le Q (axi_point I2 c2) (am_rec N (am_run N [chk2; cmt2; crt2] (ax_load I2 a b))) <-> axi_meaning I2 c2 (ax_load I2 a b)) -> axi_meaning I1 c1 (ax_load I1 a1 b1) -> axi_meaning I2 c2 (ax_load I2 a2 b2) -> let s0 := (ax_load I1 a1 b1, ax_load I2 a2 b2) in let tr := [inl chk1; inl cmt1; inl crt1; inr chk2; inr cmt2; inr crt2] in axi_clean cmpz_iface s0 /\ ax_record_moves cmpz_iface tr = 6 /\ bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) (axi_point I1 c1, axi_point I2 c2) (am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0))

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_thiele_complete
verdicts.statement: forall {A B P Q} (M : amachine A P) (N : amachine B Q), ax_thiele_complete M -> ax_thiele_complete N -> ax_thiele_complete (cmpz_prod M N)

verdicts.name: cmpz_or_bit_iff
verdicts.statement: forall s, cmpz_or_bit s = true <-> ~ bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) (am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) s) (axi_floor (cmpz_iface I1 I2))

verdicts.name: cmpz_record_moves_le_length

verdicts.name: cmpz_and_costs_six
verdicts.statement: forall (tr : list (am_move (cmpz_prod M N))) s0, axi_clean (cmpz_iface I1 I2) s0 -> cmpz_and_bit (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0) = true -> ax_record_moves (cmpz_iface I1 I2) tr >= 6

verdicts.name: cmpz_prog_trace

verdicts.name: cmpz_rights_map_inl
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l : list X), cmpz_rights (map (@inl X Y) l) = []

verdicts.name: cmpz_lefts_map_inr

verdicts.name: cmpz_rights_map_inr
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (l : list Y), cmpz_rights (map (@inr X Y) l) = l

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_runs_two
verdicts.statement: forall (u1 : T.universal_base (am_bare M)) (u2 : T.universal_base (am_bare N)) P1 P2 n1 n2 a b c d, exists tr : list (am_move (cmpz_prod M N)), T.ub_window u1 (fst (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (T.ub_load u1 a b, T.ub_load u2 c d))) = T.cm_run n1 P1 (1, (a, b)) /\ T.ub_window u2 (snd (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (T.ub_load u1 a b, T.ub_load u2 c d))) = T.cm_run n2 P2 (1, (c, d)) /\ T.ub_live u1 (fst (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (T.ub_load u1 a b, T.ub_load u2 c d))) /\ T.ub_live u2 (snd (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (T.ub_load u1 a b, T.ub_load u2 c d)))

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_total_eq

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_or_run

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_and_run
verdicts.statement: forall C1 C2 tr s, cs_run (cmpz_cs_and C1 C2) tr s = (cs_run C1 (cmpz_lefts tr) (fst s), cs_run C2 (cmpz_rights tr) (snd s))

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_and_total

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_and_floor

verdicts.name: cmpz_cs_and_tight
verdicts.statement: forall C1 C2 s1 s2 (tr1 : list (cs_instr C1)) (tr2 : list (cs_instr C2)), cs_cert C1 s1 = false -> cs_cert C2 s2 = false -> cs_cert C1 (cs_run C1 tr1 s1) = true -> cs_total_cost C1 tr1 = 1 -> cs_cert C2 (cs_run C2 tr2 s2) = true -> cs_total_cost C2 tr2 = 1 -> exists tr : list (cs_instr C1 + cs_instr C2), cs_cert (cmpz_cs_and C1 C2) (cs_run (cmpz_cs_and C1 C2) tr (s1, s2)) = true /\ cs_total_cost (cmpz_cs_and C1 C2) tr = 2

verdicts.name: cmpz_hom_comp_cong

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_universal

verdicts.name: cmpz_hom_trace_cost_exact
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (f : cmpz_hom X Y), cmpz_hom_cost_exact f -> forall (tr : list (am_move (ob_M X))) s, exists tr' : list (am_move (ob_M Y)), h_state f (am_run (ob_M X) tr s) = am_run (ob_M Y) tr' (h_state f s) /\ cmpz_cost (ob_M Y) tr' = cmpz_cost (ob_M X) tr

verdicts.name: cmpz_comp_cost_ge

verdicts.name: cmpz_assoc_iso

verdicts.name: cmpz_unit_r_iso

verdicts.name: cmpz_sim_exit_cost
verdicts.statement: forall {X Y} (f : cmpz_hom X Y), (forall a b, bp_le (ob_P Y) (h_rec f a) (h_rec f b) -> bp_le (ob_P X) a b) -> ax_a2 (X := am_axsys (ob_M Y)) -> forall s m (tr : list (am_move (ob_M Y))), h_state f (am_step (ob_M X) s m) = am_run (ob_M Y) tr (h_state f s) -> ax_exits (X := am_axsys (ob_M X)) s m -> cmpz_cost (ob_M Y) tr >= 1

verdicts.name: cmpz_follow_cost_ge_exits

verdicts.name: cmpz_interleaving_invariant

verdicts.name: cmpz_prod_shadow_theorem
verdicts.statement: (~ exists f : T.cm_conf -> A * B, forall a b tr, am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (ax_load I a b)) = f (ax_window I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (ax_load I a b)))) /\ (~ exists f : T.cm_conf -> nat, forall a b tr, axi_ledger I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (ax_load I a b)) = f (ax_window I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr (ax_load I a b)))) /\ (forall is s, T.ub_live (axi_base I) s -> ax_window I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) (map (T.ub_compile (axi_base I)) is) s) = W.cm_runl is (ax_window I s) /\ T.ub_live (axi_base I) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) (map (T.ub_compile (axi_base I)) is) s) /\ am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) (map (T.ub_compile (axi_base I)) is) s) = am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) s /\ axi_ledger I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) (map (T.ub_compile (axi_base I)) is) s) = axi_ledger I s) /\ (forall a, ~ bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) a (axi_floor I) -> forall s0 tr, axi_clean I s0 -> bp_le (cmpz_pair_pre P Q) a (am_rec (cmpz_prod M N) (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0)) -> ax_record_moves I tr >= 3 /\ axi_ledger I (am_run (cmpz_prod M N) tr s0) >= axi_ledger I s0 + 3)

verdicts.statement: forall nv Px iQ v1 i2 v2 w1, cmp_simul nv v1 w1 -> sss_output (cmp_fstep nv) Px (fst Px, v1) (i2, v2) -> exists w2, cmp_simul nv v2 w2 /\ sss_output mmstep (iQ, cmp_code nv Px iQ) (iQ, w1) (iQ + length (cmp_code nv Px iQ), w2)

verdicts.name: cmp_mm_output_conv
verdicts.statement: forall nv Px iQ v1 j w1 w2, cmp_simul nv v1 w1 -> sss_output mmstep (iQ, cmp_code nv Px iQ) (iQ, w1) (j, w2) -> exists i2 v2, cmp_simul nv v2 w2 /\ sss_output (cmp_fstep nv) Px (fst Px, v1) (i2, v2) /\ j = iQ + length (cmp_code nv Px iQ)

verdicts.name: cmp_mm_load_simul
verdicts.statement: forall nv xs, cmp_simul nv (cmp_init xs) (cmp_mm_load nv xs)

verdicts.name: cmp_flat_length
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, length (cmp_flat p nin out) = cmp_flen (cmp_inlined p nin out)

verdicts.name: cmp_stageA_fwd
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs e1 c, cmp_ceval (cp_procs p) (cmp_init xs) (cp_main p) e1 c -> exists w2, (forall x, x < cmp_nv0 p nin out -> w2 (S x) = e1 x) /\ sss_output mmstep (1, cmp_mm_prog p nin out) (1, cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs) (1 + length (cmp_mm_prog p nin out), w2)

verdicts.name: cmp_stageA_bwd
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs j w2, sss_output mmstep (1, cmp_mm_prog p nin out) (1, cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs) (j, w2) -> exists e1 c, cmp_ceval (cp_procs p) (cmp_init xs) (cp_main p) e1 c /\ j = 1 + length (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) /\ (forall x, x < cmp_nv0 p nin out -> w2 (S x) = e1 x)

verdicts.name: cmp_stageA
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs y, cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists j w2, sss_output mmstep (1, cmp_mm_prog p nin out) (1, cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs) (j, w2) /\ w2 (S out) = y

verdicts.name: cmp_gicomp_length
verdicts.statement: forall k r lnk n x, length (cmp_gicomp k r lnk n x) = cmp_gilen k x

verdicts.name: cmp_gstep_total
verdicts.statement: forall k r x st, exists st2, cmp_gstep k r x st st2

verdicts.name: cmp_gicomp_sound
verdicts.statement: forall k r, instruction_compiler_sound (cmp_gicomp k r) (cmp_gstep k r) cg_ystep (cg_simul k)

verdicts.name: cmp_gwrap_map
verdicts.statement: forall k Q H, map (cmp_gxi k) (cmp_gwrap k Q H) = map XMM Q

verdicts.name: cmp_gwrap_length
verdicts.statement: forall k Q H, length (cmp_gwrap k Q H) = length Q

verdicts.name: cmp_length_compiler_map
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (lc : B -> nat) (L : list A), length_compiler (fun x => lc (f x)) L = length_compiler lc (map f L)

verdicts.name: cmp_link_map
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (lc : B -> nat) (L : list A) i j, link (fun x => lc (f x)) i L j = link lc i (map f L) j

verdicts.name: cmp_linker_map
verdicts.statement: forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (lc : B -> nat) i0 (L : list A) i err, linker (fun x => lc (f x)) (i0, L) i err = linker lc (i0, map f L) i err

verdicts.name: cmp_comp_map
verdicts.statement: forall (A B Y : Type) (f : A -> B) (ic : (nat -> nat) -> nat -> B -> list Y) (lc : B -> nat) (lnk : nat -> nat) (L : list A) i j, comp (fun l n x => ic l n (f x)) (fun x => lc (f x)) lnk i L j = comp ic lc lnk i (map f L) j

verdicts.name: cmp_gerr_eq
verdicts.statement: 1 + length_compiler (cmp_gilen k) (snd cmp_gP) = cg_err (1, map XMM Q) 1

verdicts.name: cmp_glink_eq
verdicts.statement: linker (cmp_gilen k) cmp_gP 1 (1 + length_compiler (cmp_gilen k) (snd cmp_gP)) = cg_link (1, map XMM Q) 1

verdicts.name: cmp_gcode_eq
verdicts.statement: compiler (cmp_gicomp k r) (cmp_gilen k) cmp_gP 1 (1 + length_compiler (cmp_gilen k) (snd cmp_gP)) = cg_code k r (1, map XMM Q) 1

verdicts.name: cmp_gstep_lift
verdicts.statement: forall k r (L : list (cmp_gx k)) n i e j e', sss_steps (cmp_gstep k r) (1, L) n (i, e) (j, e') -> sss_steps (cg_xstep k r) (1, map (cmp_gxi k) L) n (i, e) (j, e')

verdicts.name: cmp_g_complete
verdicts.statement: forall k r Q (Hq : forall J, In J Q -> cg_xreg J < k) v1 w1 j w2, cg_simul k v1 w1 -> sss_output cg_ystep (1, cg_code k r (1, map XMM Q) 1) (1, w1) (j, w2) -> exists i2 v2, cg_simul k v2 w2 /\ sss_output (cg_xstep k r) (1, map XMM Q) (1, v1) (i2, v2) /\ j = 1 + length (cg_code k r (1, map XMM Q) 1)

verdicts.name: cmp_xunlift
verdicts.statement: forall k r (Q : list (mm_instr nat)) n i e a j e' a', sss_steps (cg_xstep k r) (1, map XMM Q) n (i, (e, a)) (j, (e', a')) -> a' = a /\ sss_steps mmstep (1, Q) n (i, e) (j, e')

verdicts.name: cmp_icomp_xmm_map
verdicts.statement: forall k r lnk i J, exists l : list (mm_instr (pos 2)), cg_icomp k r lnk i (XMM J) = map YMMA l

verdicts.name: cmp_comp_ymma
verdicts.statement: forall k r lnk (L : list (mm_instr nat)) i j y, In y (comp (cg_icomp k r) cg_ilen lnk i (map XMM L) j) -> exists J, y = YMMA J

verdicts.name: cmp_gcode_ymma
verdicts.statement: forall k r Q y, In y (cg_code k r (1, map XMM Q) 1) -> exists J, y = YMMA J

verdicts.name: cmp_ystep_ex
verdicts.statement: forall J i s, G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> exists j s', cg_ystep (YMMA J) (i, s) (j, s')

verdicts.name: cmp_pr_halted_out
verdicts.statement: forall (Qy : list cg_yinstr) (s : cg_ystate), (forall y, In y Qy -> exists J, y = YMMA J) -> G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> P.pr_halted (map cg_tr Qy) (G.core_of s) -> out_code (G.pc (G.core_of s)) (1, Qy)

verdicts.name: cmp_lift_run_conv
verdicts.statement: forall (Qy : list cg_yinstr), (forall y, In y Qy -> exists J, y = YMMA J) -> forall n s, G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> P.pr_halted (map cg_tr Qy) (G.core_of (P.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (map cg_tr Qy) s)) -> exists s', P.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (map cg_tr Qy) s = s' /\ G.err (G.core_of s') = false /\ sss_output cg_ystep (1, Qy) (G.pc (G.core_of s), s) (G.pc (G.core_of s'), s')

verdicts.name: cmp_pr_out_halted
verdicts.statement: forall (Qy : list cg_yinstr) (s : cg_ystate), G.err (G.core_of s) = false -> out_code (G.pc (G.core_of s)) (1, Qy) -> P.pr_halted (map cg_tr Qy) (G.core_of s)

verdicts.name: cmp_guest_final_of
verdicts.statement: forall k Q e s, cg_simul k (e, cg_mkaux 0 false false) s -> P.pr_halted (cmp_gprog k Q) (G.core_of s) -> G.pc (G.core_of s) = 1 + length (cmp_gprog k Q) -> cmp_guest_final k Q e s

verdicts.name: cmp_guest_fwd
verdicts.statement: forall k Q, (forall J, In J Q -> cg_xreg J < k) -> forall e0, (forall x, k <= x -> e0 x = 0) -> forall j e1, sss_output mmstep (1, Q) (1, e0) (j, e1) -> exists n, cmp_guest_final k Q e1 (P.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (cmp_gprog k Q) (cmp_gstart k e0))

verdicts.name: cmp_guest_bwd
verdicts.statement: forall k Q, (forall J, In J Q -> cg_xreg J < k) -> forall e0, (forall x, k <= x -> e0 x = 0) -> forall n, P.pr_halted (cmp_gprog k Q) (G.core_of (P.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (cmp_gprog k Q) (cmp_gstart k e0))) -> exists j e1, sss_output mmstep (1, Q) (1, e0) (j, e1) /\ cmp_guest_final k Q e1 (P.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (cmp_gprog k Q) (cmp_gstart k e0))

verdicts.name: cmp_hstep_fun
verdicts.statement: forall I st st1 st2, cmp_hstep I st st1 -> cmp_hstep I st st2 -> st1 = st2

verdicts.name: cmp_hcomp_length
verdicts.statement: forall lnk i I, length (cmp_hcomp lnk i I) = cmp_hlen I

verdicts.name: cmp_hprog_one
verdicts.statement: forall (i : cmp_hi) a e st2 P, (a, [i]) <sc P -> cmp_hstep i (a, e) st2 -> sss_step cmp_hstep P (a, e) st2

verdicts.name: cmp_hcomp_sound
verdicts.statement: instruction_compiler_sound cmp_hcomp mmstep cmp_hstep cmp_hsim

verdicts.name: cmp_mm_total
verdicts.statement: forall I st, exists st2, mmstep I st st2

verdicts.name: cmp_mm_fun2
verdicts.statement: forall I st st1 st2, mmstep I st st1 -> mmstep I st st2 -> st1 = st2

verdicts.name: cmp_hcode_length
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ, length (cmp_hcode Px iQ) = length_compiler cmp_hlen (snd Px)

verdicts.name: cmp_hlink_start
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ, cmp_hlink Px iQ (fst Px) = iQ

verdicts.name: cmp_hlink_out
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ j, out_code j Px -> cmp_hlink Px iQ j = iQ + length_compiler cmp_hlen (snd Px)

verdicts.name: cmp_hsubcode
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ i rho, (i, [rho]) <sc Px -> (cmp_hlink Px iQ i, cmp_hcomp (cmp_hlink Px iQ) i rho) <sc (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) /\ cmp_hlink Px iQ (1 + i) = cmp_hlen rho + cmp_hlink Px iQ i

verdicts.name: cmp_host_sound
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ i1 v1 i2 v2 w1, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> sss_compute mmstep Px (i1, v1) (i2, v2) -> exists w2, cmp_hsim v2 w2 /\ sss_compute cmp_hstep (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) (cmp_hlink Px iQ i1, w1) (cmp_hlink Px iQ i2, w2)

verdicts.name: cmp_host_complete
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ i1 v1 w1 st, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> sss_output cmp_hstep (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) (cmp_hlink Px iQ i1, w1) st -> exists i2 v2 w2, cmp_hsim v2 w2 /\ sss_output mmstep Px (i1, v1) (i2, v2) /\ sss_output cmp_hstep (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) (cmp_hlink Px iQ i2, w2) st

verdicts.name: cmp_host_output
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ v1 i2 v2 w1, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> sss_output mmstep Px (fst Px, v1) (i2, v2) -> exists w2, cmp_hsim v2 w2 /\ sss_output cmp_hstep (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) (iQ, w1) (iQ + length (cmp_hcode Px iQ), w2)

verdicts.name: cmp_host_output_conv
verdicts.statement: forall Px iQ v1 j w1 w2, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> sss_output cmp_hstep (iQ, cmp_hcode Px iQ) (iQ, w1) (j, w2) -> exists i2 v2, cmp_hsim v2 w2 /\ sss_output mmstep Px (fst Px, v1) (i2, v2) /\ j = iQ + length (cmp_hcode Px iQ)

verdicts.name: cmp_mm_hstep_total
verdicts.statement: forall h i e, exists st2, cmp_hstep h (i, e) st2

verdicts.name: cmp_hsame_refl
verdicts.statement: forall s, cmp_hsame s s

verdicts.name: cmp_hsame_trans
verdicts.statement: forall s t u, cmp_hsame s t -> cmp_hsame t u -> cmp_hsame s u

verdicts.name: cmp_hfetch
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) a h, (a, [h]) <sc (1, H) -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.fetch (cmp_hprog H) a = Some (cmp_hconv h)

verdicts.name: cmp_hfetch_none
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) a, out_code a (1, H) -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.fetch (cmp_hprog H) a = None

verdicts.name: cmp_hfetch_some
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) a, in_code a (1, H) -> exists h, (a, [h]) <sc (1, H)

verdicts.name: cmp_cexec_inc
verdicts.statement: forall k r, Minimal.EarnedMulti.err k = false -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.cexec prop_eqb eval k (Minimal.EarnedMulti.INC r) = Minimal.EarnedMulti.write k r (S (Minimal.EarnedMulti.vals k r)) (S (Minimal.EarnedMulti.pc k))

verdicts.name: cmp_cexec_dec
verdicts.statement: forall k r j, Minimal.EarnedMulti.err k = false -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.cexec prop_eqb eval k (Minimal.EarnedMulti.DEC r j) = match Minimal.EarnedMulti.vals k r with | 0 => Minimal.EarnedMulti.goto k (S (Minimal.EarnedMulti.pc k)) | S n => Minimal.EarnedMulti.write k r n j end

verdicts.name: cmp_hstep_run
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) h a e st2 s, (a, [h]) <sc (1, H) -> cmp_hrel s a e -> cmp_hstep h (a, e) st2 -> cmp_hrel (Minimal.EarnedMulti.step prop_eqb eval (cmp_hprog H) s) (fst st2) (snd st2) /\ cmp_hsame s (Minimal.EarnedMulti.step prop_eqb eval (cmp_hprog H) s)

verdicts.name: cmp_hhalted
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) s a e, cmp_hrel s a e -> out_code a (1, H) -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.halted (cmp_hprog H) (Minimal.EarnedMulti.core_of s)

verdicts.name: cmp_hhalted_out
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) s a e, cmp_hrel s a e -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.halted (cmp_hprog H) (Minimal.EarnedMulti.core_of s) -> out_code a (1, H)

verdicts.name: cmp_host_run_fwd
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) k i e j e' s, sss_steps cmp_hstep (1, H) k (i, e) (j, e') -> cmp_hrel s i e -> cmp_hrel (Minimal.EarnedMulti.run_prog prop_eqb eval k (cmp_hprog H) s) j e' /\ cmp_hsame s (Minimal.EarnedMulti.run_prog prop_eqb eval k (cmp_hprog H) s)

verdicts.name: cmp_host_run_bwd
verdicts.statement: forall (H : list cmp_hi) n i e s, cmp_hrel s i e -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.halted (cmp_hprog H) (Minimal.EarnedMulti.core_of (Minimal.EarnedMulti.run_prog prop_eqb eval n (cmp_hprog H) s)) -> exists j e', sss_output cmp_hstep (1, H) (i, e) (j, e') /\ cmp_hrel (Minimal.EarnedMulti.run_prog prop_eqb eval n (cmp_hprog H) s) j e' /\ cmp_hsame s (Minimal.EarnedMulti.run_prog prop_eqb eval n (cmp_hprog H) s)

verdicts.name: cmp_hrel_start
verdicts.statement: forall w, cmp_hrel (@Minimal.EarnedMulti.start prop w) 1 w

verdicts.name: cmp_host_final_of
verdicts.statement: forall Q w s j e', cmp_hrel s j e' -> cmp_hsame (@Minimal.EarnedMulti.start prop w) s -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.halted (cmp_hprog (cmp_host_prog Q)) (Minimal.EarnedMulti.core_of s) -> j = 1 + length (cmp_host_prog Q) -> cmp_host_final Q e' s

verdicts.name: cmp_host_fwd
verdicts.statement: forall Q v1 j v2 w1, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> sss_output mmstep (1, Q) (1, v1) (j, v2) -> exists n, cmp_host_final Q v2 (cmp_host_at Q w1 n)

verdicts.name: cmp_host_bwd
verdicts.statement: forall Q v1 w1 n, cmp_hsim v1 w1 -> Minimal.EarnedMulti.halted (cmp_hprog (cmp_host_prog Q)) (Minimal.EarnedMulti.core_of (cmp_host_at Q w1 n)) -> exists j v2, sss_output mmstep (1, Q) (1, v1) (j, v2) /\ cmp_host_final Q v2 (cmp_host_at Q w1 n)

verdicts.name: cmp_prog_regs_lt
verdicts.statement: forall Q J, In J Q -> cg_xreg J < S (cmp_prog_regs Q)

verdicts.name: cmp_gk_wf
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out J, In J (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) -> cg_xreg J < cmp_gk p nin out

verdicts.name: cmp_load_zero
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out xs x, cmp_gk p nin out <= x -> cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs x = 0

verdicts.name: cmp_pipeline_host
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) (prop_eqb : prop -> prop -> bool) (eval : prop -> nat -> bool) p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs y, cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists n v2, @cmp_host_final prop (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) v2 (@cmp_host_at prop prop_eqb eval (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) (cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs) n) /\ v2 (S out) = y

verdicts.name: cmp_guest_at_eq
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out xs n, cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n = Minimal.EarnedPriced.pr_run_prog cg_uprop_eqb cg_ueval n (cmp_gprog (cmp_gk p nin out) (cmp_mm_prog p nin out)) (cmp_gstart (cmp_gk p nin out) (cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs))

verdicts.name: cmp_out_lt_gk
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, S out < cmp_gk p nin out

verdicts.name: cmp_out_lt_nv0
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, out < cmp_nv0 p nin out

verdicts.name: cmp_pipeline_guest
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs y, cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists n, Minimal.EarnedPriced.pr_halted (cmp_guest p nin out) (Minimal.EarnedGeneric.core_of (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n)) /\ cmp_guest_answer out (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n) = y

verdicts.name: cmp_pipeline_guest_final
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs n, Minimal.EarnedPriced.pr_halted (cmp_guest p nin out) (Minimal.EarnedGeneric.core_of (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n)) -> exists e1, cmp_guest_final (cmp_gk p nin out) (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) e1 (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n)

verdicts.name: cmp_pipeline_U
verdicts.statement: forall p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs y, cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists t, M.pu_halted U_P (M.core_of (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t)) /\ cg_expo (qs (S out)) (hv (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) pu_RB) = y /\ hv (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) pu_RA = 0 /\ M.mu (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) = 0 /\ M.cert (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) = false

verdicts.name: cmp_pipeline
verdicts.statement: forall (prop : Type) (prop_eqb : prop -> prop -> bool) (eval : prop -> nat -> bool) p nin out, cmp_wf p -> forall xs y, (cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists n v2, @cmp_host_final prop (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) v2 (@cmp_host_at prop prop_eqb eval (cmp_mm_prog p nin out) (cmp_mm_load (cmp_nvF p nin out) xs) n) /\ v2 (S out) = y) /\ (cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists n, Minimal.EarnedPriced.pr_halted (cmp_guest p nin out) (Minimal.EarnedGeneric.core_of (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n)) /\ cmp_guest_answer out (cmp_guest_at p nin out xs n) = y) /\ (cmp_src_computes p xs out y <-> exists t, M.pu_halted U_P (M.core_of (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t)) /\ cg_expo (qs (S out)) (hv (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) pu_RB) = y /\ hv (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) pu_RA = 0 /\ M.mu (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) = 0 /\ M.cert (cmp_U_at p nin out xs t) = false)

verdicts.name: cr_get_0
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (t : cr_tr A), cr_get t 0 = cr_v t

verdicts.name: cr_get_S
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (t : cr_tr A) a, cr_get t (S a) = if Nat.eqb (a mod 2) 0 then cr_get (cr_l t) (a / 2) else cr_get (cr_r t) (a / 2)

verdicts.name: cr_divmod
verdicts.statement: forall a, a = 2 * (a / 2) + a mod 2 /\ a mod 2 < 2

verdicts.name: cr_get_set_f
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) f (t : cr_tr A) k x k', k < f -> cr_get (cr_set_f f t k x) k' = if Nat.eqb k' k then Some x else cr_get t k'

verdicts.name: cr_get_set
verdicts.statement: forall (A : Type) (t : cr_tr A) k x k', cr_get (cr_set t k x) k' = if Nat.eqb k' k then Some x else cr_get t k'

verdicts.name: cr_build_out
verdicts.statement: forall H a t k, (k < a \/ a + length H <= k) -> cr_get (cr_build H a t) k = cr_get t k

verdicts.name: cr_build_in
verdicts.statement: forall H a t k, a <= k -> k < a + length H -> cr_get (cr_build H a t) k = nth_error H (k - a)

verdicts.name: cr_ptab_get
verdicts.statement: forall H a, cr_get (cr_ptab H) a = match a with 0 => None | S a' => nth_error H a' end

verdicts.name: cr_ptab_none

verdicts.name: small_chsh_tol_program_bound
verdicts.statement: forall p q n P vs, TM.cert (TM.run_prog small_chsh_prop_eqb (small_chsh_tol_eval p q) n P (TM.start vs)) = true -> exists pre c rest, TM.trace_of small_chsh_prop_eqb (small_chsh_tol_eval p q) n P (TM.start vs) = pre ++ TM.CHECK small_chsh_PCHSH c :: rest /\ let t := small_chsh_tally_of (TM.vals (TM.core_of (TM.run small_chsh_prop_eqb (small_chsh_tol_eval p q) pre (TM.start vs))) c) in (small_chsh_score t * small_chsh_score t <= 8 * ((1 + IZR p / IZR q) * (1 + IZR p / IZR q)))%R

verdicts.name: small_chsh_tol_cs_cost
verdicts.statement: forall p q tr, cs_total_cost (small_chsh_tol_cs p q) tr = TM.total_cost tr

verdicts.name: small_chsh_tol_certified_floor
verdicts.statement: forall p q s0 tr, TM.clean_start s0 -> TM.cert (TM.run small_chsh_prop_eqb (small_chsh_tol_eval p q) tr s0) = true -> cs_total_cost (small_chsh_tol_cs p q) tr >= 3

verdicts.name: small_chsh_tol_noisy_certifies
verdicts.statement: TM.cert (TM.run_prog small_chsh_prop_eqb (small_chsh_tol_eval 1 10) 4 (small_chsh_chain 0) (TM.start (fun _ => small_chsh_code (small_chsh_mk 86 14 85 15 86 14 14 86)))) = true
